item.hextale.unstable_hextech.tooltip: Hums and trembles in my palm.
item.hextale.grapple_gauntlet.hint: A claw on a cord of light. It does not pull - it holds: I fall, the cord catches, and I swing. How far would one swing carry me?
item.hextale.grapple_gauntlet.controls: Hold right click: throw and hang on. Release: let go. Jump: reel in. Sneak: let out.
jei.hextale.info.grapple_gauntlet: The pylons' tendril with a claw at its end: it bites into stone and holds. A rope, not a pull - I drop until it catches me, then swing through and up. Letting go at the top of a swing throws me on, and the trick is to catch the next wall before the ground catches me. (Hold right click to hang on, jump - reel in, sneak - let out)
grapple_rune.hextale.breath.desc: The ground forgives me for a while after I let go.
grapple_rune.hextale.gravity.desc: The claw bites into a creature too and yanks it to me.
grapple_rune.hextale.blades.desc: The claw cuts what it bites.
book.hextale.quest.grapple_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the gauntlet.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_grapple: Put the Grapple Gauntlet in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a gauntlet
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the gauntlet holds three runes
quest.hextale.grapple_gauntlet.desc: A cord of light thrown from my own hand, a claw at its end. If it caught on a ledge, would it hold me?
block.hextale.disintegrator.hint: Whatever falls in comes apart into something dark and nameless.
jei.hextale.info.disintegrator: A bowl with a dark floor: whatever I drop in comes apart, thing by thing, into unknown essence that runs out of the bottom into a jar or a pipe. The burner drinks it gladly. But the land around feels thinner afterwards... what is it giving away?
disintegrator_rune.hextale.dam.desc: More of each thing is caught on the way out.
disintegrator_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Sometimes a thing leaves a little experience behind.
disintegrator_rune.hextale.hush.desc: Less of the unmaking seeps into the land.
book.hextale.quest.disintegrator_rune.no: Room for %s runes in the bowl.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_disintegra: Put the Disintegrator in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a disintegrator
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the bowl holds three runes
quest.hextale.disintegrator.desc: Chests of junk, and nowhere to put it. If a thing can be boiled apart, could it be unmade completely - down to dark murk? The land might not thank me for it.
block.hextale.world_anchor.hint: It holds its piece of the world awake, even when I am far away - as long as the jars beside it feed it earth.
block.hextale.world_anchor.status: Holds %s chunks, eats %s mB of earth essence a minute
block.hextale.world_anchor.asleep: Asleep: no earth essence in the jars around it
jei.hextale.info.world_anchor: A gemstone in nullstone and brass that grips the ground it stands on: its chunk stays loaded and ticking while it stands, wherever I am. Furnaces burn, farms grow, machines work. It eats earth essence from the jars around it every minute, the more the more it holds; when they run dry, it falls asleep and lets go. Can it hold more than its own piece? (Right click with an empty hand - what it holds)
world_anchor_rune.hextale.shift.desc: It holds the chunks around its own too.
world_anchor_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Time runs faster in what it holds: things grow and change sooner.
world_anchor_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Now and then a plant in what it holds gets a pinch of growth.
world_anchor_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Now and then a minute of holding costs no earth essence.
book.hextale.quest.world_anchor_rune.not: Room for %s runes in the anchor.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_world_anch: Put the World Anchor in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a world anchor
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the anchor holds three runes
quest.hextale.world_anchor.desc: The world falls asleep behind me wherever I leave it. A gemstone gripped in nullstone might keep one piece of it awake - as long as the jars beside it feed it earth.
item.hextale.spawner_cage.hint: A cage for the thing that makes monsters. It folds it small - but it unfolds only once.
item.hextale.spawner_cage.full_hint: Something in it is still breathing out monsters. Where should it live now?
item.hextale.spawner_cage.controls: (Right click a spawner - fold it in; right click a block - set it there)
jei.hextale.info.spawner_cage: Iron bars bent by the altar around two raw orbs. Pressed to a monster spawner it folds the spawner in, whole; pressed to a block it sets it there - and the cage burns out doing it. A farm wherever I want it?
quest.hextale.spawner_cage.desc: Could a cage fold the very thing that makes monsters? It would have to be strong - and maybe it can only do it once.
item.hextale.soul_flask.too_heavy: It holds too much to fit in the flask
item.hextale.soul_flask.hint: It folds a living thing into the glass - whole, saddle and name and all - and lets it out where I want.
item.hextale.soul_flask.controls: (Right click a creature - take it in; right click a block - let it out)
jei.hextale.info.soul_flask: A bottle the altar taught to hold a soul. A creature I touch with it folds inside, whole; touching a block lets it out there. No players, nothing as great as a dragon. My farm can move house now.
soul_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A young one steps out grown.
soul_rune.hextale.slumber.desc: A hostile one steps out asleep and stands still for a while.
book.hextale.quest.soul_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the flask.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_soul: Put an empty Soul Flask in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a soul flask
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the flask holds three runes
quest.hextale.soul_flask.desc: Could a bottle fold a living thing small and keep it, the way a rift folds the world? Soul sand for the soul, a pearl for the folding.
item.hextale.recall_charm.hint: Its hand runs backwards. Wind it, and I am where I stood a few heartbeats ago - not my wounds, though. Every turn back costs it a sip of rift essence.
item.hextale.recall_charm.controls: (Right click - go back; right click a jar - wind it with rift essence)
item.hextale.recall_charm.nowhere: The charm has nowhere to take you back to
item.hextale.recall_charm.unwound: The charm has run down: wind it at a jar of rift essence
item.hextale.recall_charm.no_rift: No rift essence in this jar
jei.hextale.info.recall_charm: A clock that learned to run backwards at the altar. Used, it puts me back where I stood five seconds ago, in this same world, and then it has to rest. Each return spends one of its windings; a jar of rift essence winds it again. Handy at a cliff edge - or in lava. (Right click a jar with the charm - wind it)
recall_rune.hextale.haste.desc: It rests shorter between two recalls.
recall_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The way back mends me a little.
recall_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: The way back puts out the flames, and fire cannot touch me for a while.
recall_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Now and then a turn back costs no winding.
book.hextale.quest.recall_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the charm.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_recall: Put the Recall Charm in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a recall charm
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the charm holds three runes
quest.hextale.recall_charm.desc: A clock on the altar, a raw orb and a pearl around it. If the rift essence bends where things are, could it bend when? Only a few seconds back - but sometimes a few seconds is everything.
block.hextale.rift_gate.hint: A ring that opens onto another ring. What goes in here comes out there - once the two know each other, and while the jars beside it hold rift essence. How far apart can they stand? (Right click with a raw hextech orb, then press the crystal it turns into to the second gate)
block.hextale.rift_gate.same: The crystal already remembers this gate
block.hextale.rift_gate.lost: The gate it remembered is gone; now it remembers this one
block.hextale.rift_gate.status.none: Not linked (right click with a raw hextech orb)
block.hextale.rift_gate.dry: The gate is dry: no rift essence in the jars beside it
item.hextale.rift_link_crystal.hint: It hums towards one gate only. Pressed to another, would the two open onto each other?
jei.hextale.info.rift_gate: Two rings of nullstone and brass that open onto each other wherever they stand - even in another world. A raw hextech orb pressed to one turns into a crystal that remembers it; pressed to the second, it ties them and is spent. Whatever passes into one ring - me, a sheep, a thrown stone, a hopper's load - steps out of the other's front, and things drop into a chest under it if there is one. Liquids go too: essence piped into one ring flows out into the pipes and jars around the other, and so does water from tanks. Every crossing drinks a little rift essence from the jars beside the gate it leaves through - a creature more than a stone. Break one, and the other's empty ring only crackles. (Right click a gate with a raw hextech orb, then press the crystal to the other gate)
jei.hextale.info.rift_link_crystal: A crystal that remembers one rift gate. Pressed to another gate, it ties the two and is spent.
quest.hextale.rift_gate.desc: Two rings that open onto each other, however far apart. Something has to tell the far one about the near one - and every crossing will want its sip of rift essence.
block.hextale.impulse_plate.hint: Step on it and it throws. Shown a spot, it throws there - and the landing comes soft. Where shall I land first? (Right click with an empty hand, then right click the spot)
block.hextale.impulse_plate.aim: Right click the block it should throw to (right click the plate again to clear)
block.hextale.impulse_plate.too_far: Too far for this plate: up to %s blocks
block.hextale.impulse_plate.cleared: The plate throws along its arrow again
jei.hextale.info.impulse_plate: The levitation rune, wound tight and let go at once. Left to itself, the plate throws up and along its brass arrow. Shown a spot, it weighs whatever stands on it and throws it there instead, and the landing comes soft - a sheep flies differently from a stone, and the plate seems to know. The goggles show the arc it means to throw along. (Right click the plate with an empty hand, then right click the spot; again on the plate to forget it)
impulse_rune.hextale.shift.desc: It throws higher, and reaches farther spots.
impulse_rune.hextale.motor.desc: It throws farther along the arrow, and quicker to a spot.
impulse_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Even with no target set, whoever it throws now lands softly.
impulse_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Whoever it throws keeps running fast for a while after.
impulse_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: A hostile creature that steps on is flung back and high, and nothing softens its landing.
book.hextale.quest.impulse_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the plate.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_impulse: Put the Impulse Plate in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to an impulse plate
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the plate holds three runes
quest.hextale.impulse_plate.desc: A rune that lifts slowly could let go all at once, like a sprung trap. Whatever steps on it would fly - I should look where it points first.
block.hextale.null_lantern.hint: Its light is cold and drinks something out of the air. Nothing hostile takes shape around it by itself.
jei.hextale.info.null_lantern: Nullstone around a raw orb. Its cold light drinks the magic that lets hostile creatures form: none appear by themselves within its quiet. Spawners and those who walk in from outside are another matter.
null_rune.hextale.hush.desc: No phantoms come down on the sleepless within its quiet.
null_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: Hostile creatures inside its quiet feel the cold light bite now and then.
null_rune.hextale.silence.desc: Inside its quiet even sounds fade. When the rune is strong, not one of my steps reaches the sculk.
book.hextale.quest.null_lantern_rune.not: Room for %s runes in the lantern.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_null_lante: Put the Null Lantern in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a null lantern
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the lantern holds three runes
quest.hextale.null_lantern.desc: Nullstone makes the magic around it go quiet. Lit from inside, would the dark around it stay empty too?
block.hextale.floating_stone.hint: It does not need anything under it. Right where I point, a few steps ahead - and it stays.
jei.hextale.info.floating_stone: Smooth stone with the plate's rune turned underneath. It sets like any stone, and into thin air too: with nothing aimed at, it settles a few blocks ahead of me and stays. A bridge with no pillars? (Right click into the air)
quest.hextale.floating_stone.desc: If the plate lifts what stands on it, could a stone hold itself up? Set down where there is nothing at all, it might simply stay. (Right click into the air)
block.hextale.ward_glass.hint: My hand meets glass - and a pig walks straight through it. A pen nobody can climb out of, except me?
block.hextale.veil_glass.hint: I step through it like through mist, and nothing else can. A door that needs no opening?
jei.hextale.info.ward_glass: Glass with a rune of barrier dusted into it. It stops me, but creatures and dropped things pass as if it were not there.
jei.hextale.info.veil_glass: Glass with the rune turned the other way: I pass through, creatures do not. Arrows and the like still meet glass.
quest.hextale.sieve_glass.desc: Dust in molten glass draws a rune of barrier - but a barrier against whom? Something rotten for the creatures, a feather for myself... which way will it turn?
block.hextale.levitation_plate.hint: Whatever stands on it rises gently and hangs in the air. How high can it carry me?
jei.hextale.info.levitation_plate: A raw orb set in brass on a stone plate. The air above it lifts whatever stands there - me, a sheep, a dropped stone - up to where the column ends, and holds it there. Nobody falls hard from it. (Shift - sink down)
plate_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Whoever steps out floats down slowly for a while.
plate_rune.hextale.cache.desc: What floats at the top of the column slips into the chest or barrel that caps it.
plate_rune.hextale.slumber.desc: Creatures in the column hang asleep, harmless, and wake slowly after.
book.hextale.quest.plate_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the plate.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_plate: Put the Levitation Plate in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a levitation plate
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the plate holds three runes
quest.hextale.levitation_plate.desc: The orb floats a hair above my palm when I hold it still. Set flat in brass, would it lift more than itself? Maybe this is the first thing anyone ever tried with hextech.
item.hextale.dust_charge.hint: Packed tight, the dust waits for a blow. It cracks rock - and only rock.
jei.hextale.info.dust_charge: Hextech dust twisted into paper. Thrown, it sticks where it lands, hisses for a moment and bursts in a cold flash - the stone around it cracks apart as if I had mined it. My walls stay whole. Should I stand back further?
quest.hextale.dust_charge.desc: Packed tight, the dust bursts in a bright flash - and the stone it touched gives way. Mining by the handful? I should keep my distance.
item.hextale.tuning_fork.hint: Hold it up and listen: the nearer the hextech in the ground, the higher it hums. Struck against something, it listens for that instead.
item.hextale.tuning_fork.controls: (Hold right click - listen; Shift + right click a block - tune to it; Shift + right click the air - untune)
item.hextale.tuning_fork.untuned: The fork listens for hextech again
fork_rune.hextale.insight.desc: What it hears glows through the stone for a while.
fork_rune.hextale.signal.desc: It hears several things at once, a thread to each.
fork_rune.hextale.gemstone.desc: Untuned, it hears ores too - closer in than hextech.
book.hextale.quest.fork_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the fork.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_fork: Put the Tuning Fork in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a tuning fork
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the fork holds three runes
jei.hextale.info.tuning_fork: Two brass prongs over a raw orb. Held up, it hums when hextech is near - higher and louder the nearer, and a thread of light points the way. Struck against a block, it listens for that block. I wonder how far it can hear.
quest.hextale.tuning_fork.desc: The orb hums when it is near its own kind. Set between two prongs, maybe it would tell me where more of it lies under my feet. And if I strike it against something else? (Hold right click to listen)
item.hextale.rune_scroll.known: You already know %s as well as this scroll can teach.
item.hextale.rune_scroll.unreadable: The signs on this scroll mean nothing to me. Not yet.
item.hextale.researchers_diary.unsigned: Empty pages. The first one to open it will make it theirs.
item.hextale.researchers_diary.foreign: This is %s's diary. You cannot read it.
hextale.configuration.title: HexTale
advancements.hextale.root.title: HexTale
advancements.hextale.root.description: Hextech is not crafted. It is studied.
advancements.hextale.born_of_storm.title: Born of the Storm
advancements.hextale.born_of_storm.descr: The storm answered - the amethyst is changed.
advancements.hextale.researchers_table.d: A desk of my own at last.
advancements.hextale.first_rune.title: First Rune
advancements.hextale.first_rune.descript: The ink reached every point of the parchment.
rune.hextale.fire_water.effect: Fire over water - steam. Steam that pushes?
rune.hextale.fire_water.use: Mechanism: a steam drive that moves pistons without redstone.
rune.hextale.unknown.effect: A sign I cannot read yet.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.effect: Heat turned on the earth. Ore and sand might melt by themselves.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.use: Pickaxe: ore drops as ingots, sand as glass.
rune.hextale.fire_earth.hint: Heat aimed at ore gives ingots by itself.
rune.hextale.fire_air.effect: Fire riding the wind. A cone of flame?
rune.hextale.fire_air.use: Gauntlets: a jet of fire 5 blocks long.
rune.hextale.fire_light.effect: A flame that shines and never needs feeding. Can that be?
rune.hextale.fire_light.use: Mechanism: a lantern without fuel that lights the lanterns next to it.
rune.hextale.fire_light.hint: A flame that shines without wood, forever.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.effect: A fire that seems to hate the dark and what lives in it.
rune.hextale.fire_shadow.use: Sword: double damage to the undead, burns cobwebs.
rune.hextale.fire_life.effect: Fire that catches on the living at a touch. Careful.
rune.hextale.fire_life.use: Weapon: sets the target on fire on hit.
rune.hextale.fire_metal.effect: Fire that wants metal back. Broken things melted into ingots again?
rune.hextale.fire_metal.use: Mechanism: a smelter that returns ingots from broken tools.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.effect: All the heat at once. It feels dangerous even on paper.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.use: Drill: blasts the 3×3 blocks around the point of impact.
rune.hextale.fire_spark.hint: All the heat at once. Dangerous.
rune.hextale.water_fire.effect: Water against fire. Lava would cool into stone.
rune.hextale.water_fire.use: Staff: puts out fires around, lava turns to obsidian.
rune.hextale.water_fire.hint: Water douses fire and cools lava.
rune.hextale.water_earth.effect: Water that washes loose earth away, layer by layer.
rune.hextale.water_earth.use: Shovel: sand, gravel and dirt go in whole layers.
rune.hextale.water_air.effect: Water breathed into the air. A thick fog to hide in?
rune.hextale.water_air.use: Device: a cloud in which mobs lose their target.
rune.hextale.water_light.effect: Light gathered like a drop of water - the far looks near.
rune.hextale.water_light.use: Spyglass monocle: zooms in and highlights distant targets.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.effect: Water that drags down and holds. Like a swamp.
rune.hextale.water_shadow.use: Trap: mobs get stuck and slowly sink.
rune.hextale.water_life.use: Staff: heals creatures and players around.
rune.hextale.water_life.hint: Water washes wounds. Turn it on the living.
rune.hextale.water_metal.effect: Water that eats metal. Rust in a moment?
rune.hextale.water_metal.use: Weapon: ruins enemy armour, takes apart other people's mechanisms.
rune.hextale.water_spark.effect: A charge that hides in damp cloth and waits. Whoever touches it, gets it?
rune.hextale.water_spark.use: Mechanism: carries energy along a water channel.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.effect: Earth tempered by fire - harder, unafraid of heat. Could a tool be made like that?
rune.hextale.earth_fire.use: Any tool: loses durability half as fast, does not burn in lava.
rune.hextale.earth_fire.hint: Stone does not fear fire. Could a tool?
rune.hextale.earth_water.effect: Earth that holds water back. Even lava, maybe.
rune.hextale.earth_water.use: Device: seals water and lava behind a wall.
rune.hextale.earth_water.hint: A wall of earth holds back even lava.
rune.hextale.earth_air.effect: Earth pulling the air down. Whatever flies would fall.
rune.hextale.earth_air.use: Weapon: knocks down flying mobs, cancels knockback.
rune.hextale.earth_light.effect: Light woken inside stone. Gems where there was only rock?
rune.hextale.earth_light.use: Pickaxe: a chance to get a gem or a hextech shard.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.effect: Earth that hides things in its shadow. Something might be waiting in the soil.
rune.hextale.earth_shadow.use: Mechanism: a hidden chest that looks like any other block.
rune.hextale.earth_life.effect: Earth made fertile. Things would grow out of it gladly.
rune.hextale.earth_life.use: Hoe: farmland never dries out, crops grow faster.
rune.hextale.earth_metal.effect: Earth bound with metal. A wall that holds together.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.effect: A charge driven into the ground does not stay there. It rolls on as a wave.
rune.hextale.earth_spark.use: Mechanism: a lightning rod that protects machines from overload.
rune.hextale.air_fire.effect: Air feeding the fire. Like bellows - hotter, faster.
rune.hextale.air_fire.use: Mechanism: bellows, furnaces and smelters work twice as fast.
rune.hextale.air_water.effect: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water through pipes?
rune.hextale.air_water.use: Mechanism: a pump that drains and moves water and lava.
rune.hextale.air_water.hint: Wind drives the waves. Could it drive water?
rune.hextale.air_earth.effect: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_earth.use: Mechanism: a rune piston that moves up to 12 blocks.
rune.hextale.air_earth.hint: A gust moves dust. Why not a whole block?
rune.hextale.air_light.effect: A reflection in the air that isn't there.
rune.hextale.air_light.use: Device: an illusion that mobs attack.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.effect: Air that swallows sound. Every step goes quiet.
rune.hextale.air_shadow.use: Boots: neither mobs nor sculk can hear the player.
rune.hextale.air_life.effect: Air given to the living. A breath where there is none.
rune.hextale.air_life.use: Helmet: breathing underwater, an air bubble.
rune.hextale.air_metal.effect: Air under metal - heavy things rising like feathers.
rune.hextale.air_metal.use: Mechanism: a lift and a crane for blocks and entities.
rune.hextale.air_spark.effect: Air spun round by a charge. It sweeps whatever stands too close.
rune.hextale.air_spark.use: Mechanism: a wind generator, stronger up high.
rune.hextale.air_spark.hint: Catch the wind and make it a charge.
rune.hextale.light_fire.effect: Heat gathered into a thin beam. It would cut.
rune.hextale.light_fire.use: Cutter: cuts blocks along a line, a long-range shot.
rune.hextale.light_water.effect: Light poured into water - clean and clear. Poisons wouldn't stay.
rune.hextale.light_water.use: Flask: removes poisons and negative effects.
rune.hextale.light_earth.effect: Light sent into stone shows what hides inside.
rune.hextale.light_earth.use: Goggles: ores and caves show through walls.
rune.hextale.light_earth.hint: Light sent into stone shows what hides.
rune.hextale.light_air.effect: A beam thrown into the sky, seen from far away.
rune.hextale.light_air.use: Beacon marker: seen from afar, links devices together.
rune.hextale.light_shadow.effect: Light that drives the darkness off. And what crawls out of it?
rune.hextale.light_shadow.use: Device: hostile mobs do not spawn around it.
rune.hextale.light_life.effect: Light that feeds the living. Plants would love it - and maybe more.
rune.hextale.light_life.use: Lamp: crops grow underground and at night.
rune.hextale.light_metal.effect: A pattern burned into metal by light.
rune.hextale.light_metal.use: Workbench: transfers runes onto tools and parts.
rune.hextale.light_spark.use: Mechanism: a light panel that works by day.
rune.hextale.shadow_fire.use: Mechanism: cools overheated machines, puts furnaces out.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.effect: Shadow that soaks up any liquid.
rune.hextale.shadow_water.use: Device: drains water and lava around it.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.effect: Stone made passable for a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.shadow_earth.use: Gauntlets: walk through a wall up to 2 blocks thick.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.effect: Shadow spilled into the air hides whoever stands in it.
rune.hextale.shadow_air.hint: Shadow spilled into the air hides anyone.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.effect: Shadow behind the light: the blow nobody sees coming.
rune.hextale.shadow_light.use: Device: darkness around it, torches go out.
rune.hextale.shadow_life.effect: Shadow that drains life - and where does that life go?
rune.hextale.shadow_life.use: Weapon: part of the damage heals the wielder.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.effect: Shadow in the steel: a wound that will not close.
rune.hextale.shadow_metal.use: Weapon: enemy armour and tools break quickly.
rune.hextale.shadow_spark.use: Device: shuts down mechanisms around it.
rune.hextale.life_fire.use: Armour: immunity to fire and lava for a while.
rune.hextale.life_water.effect: Life giving birth to water. A spring from nothing?
rune.hextale.life_earth.effect: Life from the soil - sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_earth.use: Staff: trees and crops grow at once.
rune.hextale.life_earth.hint: Life from the soil: sprouts in a heartbeat.
rune.hextale.life_air.effect: Seeds carried off on the wind.
rune.hextale.life_air.use: Mechanism: plants seeds around by itself.
rune.hextale.life_light.effect: The living starts to glow. Hard to hide like that.
rune.hextale.life_light.use: Arrows: highlight the target through walls.
rune.hextale.life_shadow.use: Weapon: passive and weak mobs fall asleep.
rune.hextale.life_metal.effect: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.life_metal.hint: Life heals flesh. Could it mend steel?
rune.hextale.life_spark.effect: A spark that wakes what has stopped.
rune.hextale.metal_fire.effect: Fire locked inside metal - a furnace that is always hot.
rune.hextale.metal_fire.use: Mechanism: a rune furnace and smelter.
rune.hextale.metal_water.effect: Liquid led through metal, where I want it.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.effect: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_earth.hint: A chisel that bites into stone.
rune.hextale.metal_air.effect: Metal spinning the air - blades, wind, cutting.
rune.hextale.metal_air.use: Mechanism: a fan that blows entities and items away.
rune.hextale.metal_light.effect: Metal that throws light back. And everything else?
rune.hextale.metal_shadow.use: Device: chests and doors open only with a rune key.
rune.hextale.metal_life.effect: Metal given a semblance of life.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.effect: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.use: Mechanism: an engine for every machine.
rune.hextale.metal_spark.hint: In metal, a charge starts turning wheels.
rune.hextale.spark_fire.effect: A spark that sets things alight on a signal.
rune.hextale.spark_water.effect: Water that bites whoever stands in it.
rune.hextale.spark_water.use: Trap: damages everyone in the water.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.effect: A discharge struck into the ground. The stone would crack.
rune.hextale.spark_earth.use: Hammer: stuns everything around and crushes stone.
rune.hextale.spark_air.effect: Lightning leaping from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_air.hint: Lightning leaps from target to target.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.effect: A discharge that carries me through the shadow. A step, and I'm somewhere else.
rune.hextale.spark_shadow.use: Gauntlets: a teleporting dash of 8 blocks.
rune.hextale.spark_life.effect: A spark in the blood - faster, lighter.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.effect: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.use: Mechanism: collects dropped items and ore.
rune.hextale.spark_metal.hint: Lightning loves iron. Let it pull iron.
gui.hextale.research_table.need.diary: Put a Researcher's Diary into the diary slot.
gui.hextale.research_table.need.own_diar: This diary belongs to someone else. Bring your own.
gui.hextale.research_table.need.hextech: Put unstable hextech on the table: it lies in the middle of the parchment and goes into the research.
research.hextale.closed: %s cannot be researched yet: open its step in the book.
gui.hextale.research_table.loupe.hint: Hold and drag onto an item to study it
gui.hextale.research_table.choose: Choose what to research in the book
gui.hextale.research_table.slot.paper: Paper: every research starts on a fresh sheet
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.hint: Drawn from Essence Jars of %s concentrate around the table
block.hextale.brass_pipe.hint: A side can be shut, or the essence sent one way only. (Shift + right click a side with an empty hand)
block.hextale.brass_pipe.nothing: Nothing to join on this side
block.hextale.brass_pipe.side.out: %s: out only - the pipe pumps a jar out
block.hextale.brass_pipe.side.closed.pip: Shut off from the next pipe
item.hextale.essence_flask.drink: Tastes of what it is made of. Fire, light, air - each leaves something behind for a minute.
item.hextale.essence_flask.mixture.hint: Everything at once, all mixed up. It needs pulling apart.
gui.hextale.alembic.cold: Needs heat below: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
gui.hextale.separator.mix: Mixture: comes in through the inlets, or from a bottle
gui.hextale.separator.extract: Concentrate of the chosen essence: leaves through the concentrate outlets
gui.hextale.separator.unknown.hint: Filters the dark unknown essence out of a mixture; the rest comes out clean
gui.hextale.alembic.out: Leaves through a pipe on any side, or into glass bottles
gui.hextale.separator.rest: The rest of the mixture: leaves through the rest outlets
gui.hextale.slot.bottles: Glass bottles: the essence is bottled into them
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.input: An item to boil into essence. An unstudied one gives dark unknown essence
gui.hextale.slot.alembic.output: A filled bottle of essence comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.pour: A bottle of mixture to pour in
gui.hextale.slot.separator.extract: The bottled concentrate comes out here
gui.hextale.slot.separator.rest: The bottled rest of the mixture comes out here
gui.hextale.research_table.ink.no_storag: No storage: place an Essence Jar of %s concentrate within 5 blocks of the table
gui.hextale.separator.ports.hint: The separator seen from above, its front towards you. A side opens by itself when a pipe, a jar or an alembic is set beside it. Click a side to change what it does - or sneak-use that side of the block.
gui.hextale.port.inlet.hint: A pipe here brings the mixture in (green, arrow in)
gui.hextale.port.product.hint: The wanted product leaves here (blue, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.waste.hint: The by-product leaves here (rust, stopcock, arrow out)
gui.hextale.port.none.hint: Nothing goes in or out here; no pipe joins it
gui.hextale.separator.vent.hint: The top lets out the gas of separation
item.hextale.essence_flask.unknown.hint: Dark murk left over after separating. No good for ink. Where to put it?
block.hextale.drain_valve.open: Valve open: what the pipes bring pours out
gui.hextale.alembic.water.hint: Each item boils in %s mB. Pipe water in from a Pump on any side, or pour a water bucket on the alembic
jei.hextale.boiling.heat: Heat under the alembic: fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma
jei.hextale.boiling.result: A mixture of the item's essences - study the item at the Research Table to know them
jei.hextale.info.alembic: Boil a thing in water long enough and its essences rise out of it - but only things I have studied give anything clear; the rest boils into dark murk. It wants heat below and water inside, a little for every item. What comes out fills glass bottles or runs off through a pipe.
jei.hextale.info.separator: A flask over burning blaze powder: it draws one essence out of a mixture and leaves the rest, darkened.
jei.hextale.info.essence_tank: A big glass jar with a wooden lid. It takes from the top and the sides and gives from below. A desk nearby seems to drink from jars of pure essence.
jei.hextale.info.brass_pipe: Pipes for essence and water. They only join a machine where it has a port. A side can be shut, opened one way in, or one way out - out even pumps a jar empty. (Shift + right click a side with an empty hand)
jei.hextale.info.pump: Stood in water, it pushes the water up into the pipe on its top.
jei.hextale.info.drain_valve: A handwheel that opens or shuts it. Open, it pours out whatever the pipes bring. The stone under the stream seems to change... (Right click - open or shut)
jei.hextale.info.research_table: My desk, two blocks wide. The loupe on its arm shows what a thing is made of - I drag it onto an item and wait. On the parchment I work out devices: the diary, a hextech orb, paper, and ink drawn from the orb to every point. The ink comes from jars nearby. The finished notes teach me how to make the thing.
jei.hextale.info.essence_flask: A glass bottle of essence. One pure essence flows like ink; a mixture still needs pulling apart, and what is left after that is dark murk.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.essence_flask: a bottle in the alembic's slot
commands.hextale.quests.reset: Reset the Researcher's Path quests of %s
commands.hextale.guide.granted: Marked %1$s guide steps done for %2$s players
quest.hextale.research_table.desc: A proper desk at last, wide enough for the diary, the paper and a hextech orb. On one tab I choose what to work out, on the other I do the work. Two blocks wide - I'll need room.
quest.hextale.brass.goal: melt Brass in the Awakened Furnace
quest.hextale.brass.desc: Copper alone is too soft, but with a little zinc it melts into a warm, stubborn metal. Brass. It feels like everything I build will start with it.
quest.hextale.unstable_hextech.desc: They say lightning likes to strike a rod. What if the rod stands on amethyst? The crystal could take the strike and change... I need a thunderstorm and some patience - unless a storm did it somewhere long ago.
quest.hextale.glassy_scars.desc: Here and there the ground is fused into glass, branching out from a pit like frozen lightning. A bolt went in there - long ago, and deep. What did it hit down below?
quest.hextale.researchers_diary.desc: A plain book, a shard of amethyst, a feather - and now it's mine, with my name on the first page. Everything I find out goes in here. Without it the desk is just a desk.
quest.hextale.item_study.desc: The loupe on the desk swings out on its arm. If I drag it onto a thing and hold still while the lenses fold in, maybe I'll see what it is really made of. Are some things made of one thing only?
quest.hextale.alembic.desc: Boil a thing in water long enough and its essences rise out of it. But only things I have looked at closely give anything clear - the rest boils into dark murk. It needs heat below and water inside. And one plain thing boiled on its own... would that come out clean?
quest.hextale.brass_pipe.desc: Carrying bottles back and forth is tiring. Pipes, then. They only join a machine where it has a port - I can see the joint appear. And a side can be shut or turned one way. (Shift + right click with an empty hand)
quest.hextale.pump.desc: Water by the bucket again... What if something stood right in the spring and pushed the water up the pipe by itself?
quest.hextale.essence_bottle.desc: The alembic fills glass bottles with what it boiled out - everything the thing held, all together. Unless the thing held only one essence to begin with. And if I drank one?
quest.hextale.separator.desc: Light never comes alone - every torch boils into fire as well - and one wrong thing spoils a whole jar. If I could draw out just one essence and leave the rest... A flask over a hot enough flame might do it: blaze powder, or something hotter and cleaner. What stays behind darkens, though.
quest.hextale.drain_valve.desc: The dark rest has to go somewhere. A valve with a handwheel could pour it out... I wonder what it does to the stone it falls on.
quest.hextale.concentrate.desc: One essence, pure, drawn out of a mixture. It flows like ink. Now nothing I boil is wasted, and the desk can have what no single thing gives me.
quest.hextale.essence_tank.desc: A big glass jar to keep the essence in. It takes from the top and the sides, gives from below.
quest.hextale.ink.goal: open the table with a jar of pure essence nearby
quest.hextale.ink.desc: The desk drinks ink from the jars nearby: one clean essence to a jar, and every research wants several, so I'd better keep many jars. Coal for fire, stone for earth... Everything sealed in my diary waits to be worked out here. Let's see how far the ink will run.
goggles.hextale.network: In the vessels on this network:
quest.hextale.researchers_goggles.desc: Lenses tinted with essence... If I wear them, maybe I'll see what is inside the jars and pipes without opening anything.
research.hextale.burst: A curse! The orb burst and the parchment of %s burned with the ink spent on it. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
research.hextale.burnt: The parchment of %s burned. A fresh sheet holds a new board.
quest.hextale.hexcore.goal: wake the altar into a Hexcore
quest.hextale.hexcore.desc: A gemstone in the centre, and when the ritual ends the altar should wake up as something else - a living matrix of runes. Heavy rituals make it restless: arcs, fire, broken things. Would lightning rods around the circle catch what it throws?
jei.hextale.info.hexcore: The altar woken up: made by a ritual with a gemstone in the centre, the altar itself turns into it. Runs every altar ritual; the heavier the ritual, the more it throws arcs - at people, at fragile blocks, at the pedestals. Lightning rods in the circle catch some of them.
block.hextale.rune_circle.empty: Put a tool, a device or a blank scroll in the circle first
block.hextale.rune_circle.nothing: The circle has nothing to burn in: check the steles and the jars
block.hextale.rune_circle.hint: Runes are burned in here, nothing is made. The thing goes in the middle, runes on the steles around. (Right click with the item; Shift + right click with an empty hand - start)
block.hextale.rune_circle.elsewhere: The circle only burns runes in and copies them: things are made at the altar
block.hextale.rune_circle.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.elsewhere: The altar makes things: runes are burned in at a Rune Circle
jei.hextale.info.rune_circle: A circle cut into the floor, steles standing round it. The thing I want to change lies in the middle, and the runes run into it along the grooves. The altar makes; the circle writes. A blank scroll here takes one rune as I know it. (Shift + right click with an empty hand, or a redstone pulse)
quest.hextale.rune_circle.desc: The altar will not burn runes in. Maybe runes want a place of their own - a flat circle in the floor, steles round it, grooves for the light to run along?
block.hextale.hextech_altar.empty: Put an item on the altar first
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing: The circle does not know what to do with this: check the pedestals, steles and jars
block.hextale.hextech_altar.busy: A ritual is running - sneak + use to abort it (what was drawn is lost)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.hint: The heart of the circle. The item goes on top, and then - the ritual. (Right click with the item; Shift + right click with an empty hand - start)
gui.hextale.stele.subtitle: Choose a rune for the circle
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.twice: Already on another stele of this circle
gui.hextale.stele.none: No rune does anything for the item in the circle.
gui.hextale.stele.unknown: A rune you have not learned yet
gui.hextale.stele.choose: Click: set it on the stele
gui.hextale.stele.pick_stars: Click a star: choose the strength (weaker too)
book.hextale.quest.infusion.missing: The altar recipe is not loaded
quest.hextale.hextech_altar.desc: Everything I've read points here: a ritual circle. The item on the altar, the rest laid on pedestals around it, jars of essence close by. Then I start it and hope it holds. (Shift + right click with an empty hand)
quest.hextale.pedestal.desc: Small stands for the things a ritual needs, close to the altar. One extra thing on them and the altar frowns - it marks it in red.
quest.hextale.rune_stele.desc: A stone that holds a rune I know. Round a rune circle it lends the rune to the work... and it only offers what makes sense for the thing in the middle.
quest.hextale.hextech_pickaxe.desc: An iron pickaxe with a raw orb in a brass collar. It digs well as it is - but there is room in it for something more. Runes?
jei.hextale.info.hextech_altar: The heart of the ritual circle. The item on top, the rest on pedestals around it, jars of essence close by. When it starts, the pedestals give up their items one by one, then the jars their essences. Chalk runes drawn around it seem to hurry the work. (Shift + right click with an empty hand, or a redstone pulse)
jei.hextale.info.pedestal: A stand for one thing a ritual needs, close to the altar. As many as I like. Hoppers can fill it too.
jei.hextale.info.rune_stele: A stone that holds one rune I know. Round a rune circle it guides the work.
gui.hextale.separator.choose.hint: Click: choose from all essences. Right click: clear. Wheel: next / previous
gui.hextale.separator.missing: The mixture holds none of it
gui.hextale.separator.no_fuel: Needs blaze powder or heat below
gui.hextale.separator.no_fuel.hint: One blaze powder draws 32 mB of the chosen essence; a lit Chem Burner below heats it for free, magma or lava below slowly
gui.hextale.slot.separator.fuel: Blaze powder: burned to draw the chosen essence out
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.volatile: Looks very fragile - I'd better not drop it.
item.hextale.hextech_gemstone.tooltip: Smooth and steady, not a tremor left in it.
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.goal: finish a Hextech Gemstone on the lapidary
quest.hextale.hextech_gemstone.desc: Ground smooth and steady, it no longer trembles at all. The purest thing I've made from hextech. It feels like it could hold much more than the cut crystal.
quest.hextale.wip_gem_polish.desc: The cuttings are too bright to throw away. Rubbed into a cut crystal, would they bring it closer to a gemstone?
quest.hextale.hextech_lamp.desc: A crystal floating in a little brass cage, glowing as bright as day. It stands or hangs - wherever I need light.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_lamp: A hextech crystal floating in a brass cage. Bright as day, never goes out. Stands or hangs like a lantern.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.magic_stone: 2 lapis lazuli, then stone, into a boiling crucible
quest.hextale.magic_stone.goal: make magic stone in the crucible
quest.hextale.magic_stone.desc: Lapis gives magic to boiling water. What if stone sat in that water long enough? It might drink the magic in.
jei.hextale.info.magic_stone: Stone that drank magic. Lapis gives magic to boiling water in a crucible; plain stone dropped into that water drinks it in and rises out changed.
quest.hextale.magic_sapling.goal: grow a Magic Tree Sprout in the crucible
quest.hextale.magic_sapling.desc: A sapling is a promise of wood. Fed in a crucible on magic, plant and sap, it might promise more.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.magic_sapling: magic, plant and sap in the water, then a sapling
jei.hextale.info.magic_sapling: A sapling thrown into a crucible rich in magic, plant and sap drinks them in and comes out as something else. But first I have to understand it at the Lab Bench. Its wood won't burn.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.nothing.rune: The circle waits for runes on its steles: %s
book.hextale.quest.infusion.runes: Runes chosen on steles around the circle
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.clas: %s and %s are incompatible on one pickaxe
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pickaxe holds four runes (a grindstone takes them off)
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.noth: The pickaxe already carries these runes with as many stars
book.hextale.quest.pickaxe_rune.note: A first pickaxe holds only one rune; a better pickaxe should hold more - %s at the very best? A grindstone takes them all off again.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note: Pickaxe in the Rune Circle, rune on a stele. Runes: 1, refined 2, radiant 3, attuned %s.
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.goal: burn a rune into a runed pickaxe
quest.hextale.pickaxe_rune.desc: What if I lay the pickaxe in the rune circle and set a rune on a stele beside it? The rune might burn into the metal like an enchantment.
quest.hextale.refined_pickaxe.desc: Charged steel and an engraved diamond on top of the old pickaxe. Harder, keener - and it remembers everything the old one carried. Room for a second rune, too. Would the axe, the shovel and the sword take the same?
quest.hextale.radiant_pickaxe.desc: The pickaxe shines now and fire doesn't touch it. Stronger than anything I've held, still mine, runes and all - and there is room for a third. The other tools should shine the same way. And the cold things the Void leaves behind, laid round a Hexcore... what would they forge?
pickaxe_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: The ore comes out of the stone already hot and smelted.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.tempering.desc: The pickaxe wears slower, and hard stone gives way sooner.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Strike one piece of ore and the whole vein follows. (Shift - one block)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.insight.desc: I can almost see the ore glowing through the stone. (Right click)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.drill.desc: The stone around the blow crumbles too. (Shift - one block)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Sometimes the ore gives twice as much.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.gemstone.desc: Now and then plain stone hides a gem.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.magnet.desc: Whatever falls - and the experience - drifts to my hands.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.cache.desc: The drops skip the floor and go straight to my bag.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.passage.desc: The rock ahead opens into a tunnel. (Right click)
pickaxe_rune.hextale.quake.desc: The stone around shatters, but the ore stays whole. (Right click)
multiblock.hextale.big_essence_jar.forme: The Big Essence Jar wakes up
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.goal: build a Big Essence Jar and wake it
quest.hextale.big_essence_jar.desc: One jar is never enough. What if I build a whole jar out of glass blocks and a wooden lid, and sprinkle it with hextech dust? It would hold as much as a whole shelf of jars.
gui.hextale.multiblock.hint: The arrows step through the layers
jei.hextale.multiblock.wake: Right-click the finished structure (one is spent)
book.hextale.guide.wip_status: Only an idea in the margins so far
book.hextale.guide.no_use: No use for it yet. It feels like it leads somewhere, though.
book.hextale.guide.researched_at_lab: Worked out at the Lab Bench
item.hextale.scroll_of_omniscience.desc: Right click: learn every rune with three stars, study every item, complete every quest.
item.hextale.scroll_of_oblivion.desc: Right click: forget all runes, studied items and quests.
item.hextale.void_shard.desc: A sliver of the Void. It is cold, and the air around it seems to lean in. What happens if I point it somewhere?
item.hextale.void_shard.controls: RMB: open the Void. Shift + RMB: close the Void in sight, or pick another shape
subtitles.hextale.essence.draw: Essence is drawn from a jar
quest.hextale.wip_quench_tank.desc: A trough of coolant over a burner, the ingots sliding through one after another. Quicker than dipping them by hand - but where would all the fumes go?
quest.hextale.wip_rune_lock.desc: A chest or a door that opens only for the one who set the rune. Thieves would hate it.
quest.hextale.wip_beam_relay.desc: Mirrors passing a beam of light and power from block to block. I need to think about the angles.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_cutter.desc: A beam that cuts blocks into stairs and patterns right where they stand. No more carrying stone to the cutter.
quest.hextale.wip_signal_beacon.desc: A beam into the sky that friends can see from far away. And maybe marks to leave for them.
quest.hextale.wip_mirage_projector.desc: Ghostly blocks and pictures in the air. A false wall nobody would suspect...
quest.hextale.wip_flash_charge.desc: A charge that bursts into a blinding flash. Useful when something with too many teeth gets close.
quest.hextale.wip_storm_collector.desc: Catching lightning without the risk of a blast. If I could tame the storm, hextech would grow by itself.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_flamethrower.desc: Brews through a nozzle - acid, coolant, the burning mix. Quick and nasty work. And who breathes what is left?
quest.hextale.wip_veil.desc: A cloak that makes its wearer unseen and unheard. Tempting - and a little frightening.
quest.hextale.wip_acid_bath.desc: A bath that dissolves ore straight into essence. But what would it do to the ground around it?
quest.hextale.wip_rune_anvil.desc: Mending tools with essence instead of iron, keeping every rune and enchantment. That would save so much.
quest.hextale.wip_greenhouse.desc: Plants around it growing faster... magic stone, glass, a little light essence? Let me think.
quest.hextale.wip_healing_spring.desc: Water that heals whoever steps in. A place to come back to after a bad day underground.
quest.hextale.wip_respirator.desc: A mask against the poisonous fumes. If chemtech goes where I think it goes, I'll need one.
quest.hextale.wip_fireproof_coat.desc: A coat that fire and lava can't touch. The deep places would be a lot less scary.
quest.hextale.wip_construct.desc: A little helper that does what its runes tell it. What would I ask it to do first?
quest.hextale.wip_sap_tap.desc: A brass spout driven into a living trunk, dripping sap essence into a bottle. Essence without boiling anything - is that possible?
quest.hextale.wip_essence_sprinkler.desc: A turning head on a pipe spraying essence dew over the beds. Water to keep them moist, sap to hurry the crops.
quest.hextale.wip_living_soil.desc: Farmland soaked in essence the way stone soaks up magic. It might never dry out or get trampled.
quest.hextale.wip_seed_sower.desc: A clockwork brass bird hopping over empty farmland and planting seeds from a chest. Silly - but I'd love to see it.
quest.hextale.wip_feeding_trough.desc: A trough that feeds and breeds the animals around it and stops when the pen is full. No more running around with wheat.
quest.hextale.wip_geode_resonator.desc: A humming rod set into budding amethyst. If the crystals grew faster, there'd be more for the storms. Too many rods might crack them, though.
quest.hextale.wip_jar_gauge.desc: A dial on a jar showing how full it is - and telling redstone about it.
quest.hextale.wip_fish_weir.desc: A brass net lowered into open water, fishing by itself. Slowly - but it never gets bored.
quest.hextale.wip_compost_vat.desc: Plant scraps and the dark leftovers rotting into something useful. Better than pouring it all away.
quest.hextale.wip_experiment_pot.desc: A pot under a glass cap on the lab bench. A plant that takes a dose and changes... into what?
quest.hextale.hextech_axe.desc: Iron axe, a raw orb at the head. It bites into wood as if the tree wanted to fall.
quest.hextale.hextech_shovel.desc: It goes through sand and gravel like water, and it barely wears.
quest.hextale.hextech_sword.desc: The guard is a hexagon around the orb, and the blade hums when I swing it. A short blade for the other hand would hum along - and thrown, it might find its way back to me.
block.hextale.xp_condenser.hint: No experience orb appears around it - it drinks them all and keeps them as a glowing liquid. Right click for a level, sneak for everything, a glass bottle for a Bottle o' Enchanting.
block.hextale.xp_condenser.given: %s experience taken, %s left in the glass
block.hextale.xp_condenser.too_little: Too little in the glass for a bottle (%s needed)
quest.hextale.xp_condenser.desc: Knowledge can be bottled. The crystal pulls every spark of experience out of the air before it even takes shape, and in the glass it settles like warm green honey.
jei.hextale.info.xp_condenser: Experience orbs that would appear within 8 blocks never do: the condenser drinks them and holds the experience as a liquid (up to about level 50). A Greedy Funnel in reach pours its experience in too. Right click with an empty hand for one level, sneak for everything; a glass bottle makes a Bottle o' Enchanting. A comparator reads how full it is. Broken, it spills its experience as orbs.
quest.hextale.wip_ore_washer.desc: Raw ore washed in streams of water essence. Three pieces where there were two?
quest.hextale.wip_herd_warden.desc: A post with a soothing gem: it shears, milks, gathers eggs. The animals wouldn't even notice.
quest.hextale.wip_bloom_censer.desc: A hanging censer breathing pollen. Flowers spreading, bees working twice as hard...
quest.hextale.wip_magma_font.desc: Pour enough fire essence into stone and it should melt into lava. Expensive - but the forge would never cool.
quest.hextale.wip_rain_caller.desc: A mast that seeds the clouds with mist. Rain for the fields - or a storm for my lightning rods.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_bore.desc: A rune drill sinking a shaft into the depths layer by layer, leaving a ladder of light behind. Pickaxe runes might fit it.
quest.hextale.wip_hex_archive.desc: Shelves of rune-sealed drawers and one floating index. A hall full of chests is getting hard to live with.
quest.hextale.wip_winged_courier.desc: A little flying construct carrying things where no beam reaches - over rivers, through caves.
quest.hextale.wip_mutation_injector.desc: A needle that gives a creature a dose right where it stands. Stronger and loyal - or a monster.
quest.hextale.wip_chrono_chamber.desc: A glass dome where time runs faster for whatever is inside. How long would the glass hold?
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.gathering: Gathers within %s blocks every %s s, %s at a time · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.sending: Sends %s items every %s s, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.relay: Passes items on, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.start: Right click a storage or a relay within %s blocks to link (%s/%s); a linked one to unlink; anywhere else to stop
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.far: Too far: %s blocks, the pylon reaches %s
pylon_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The pylon reaches wider and links farther.
pylon_rune.hextale.lift.desc: The pylon carries more at once.
pylon_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: Now and then what a furnace would smelt arrives smelted.
pylon_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: Now and then stone arrives ground down: cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand.
pylon_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: A delivery now and then leaves a little experience by the target.
book.hextale.quest.pylon_rune.note: Room for %s runes in a pylon.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_pylon: Pylon in the Rune Circle, rune on a stele. Up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a pylon
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a pylon holds three runes
quest.hextale.gathering_pylon.desc: Instead of a clumsy mechanical arm - the pull of a gem. Set on a chest or a furnace, it reaches for things lying around and lowers them into what it stands on. I wonder how far it can reach.
quest.hextale.sending_pylon.desc: This one gives instead of taking: whatever the storage under it gives out, it carries to where I point. A furnace even sorts what it gets by itself. (Right click the pylon, then where it should send)
quest.hextale.relay_pylon.desc: A column that neither takes nor gives - it only passes things along. With a few of them I could reach across the whole base.
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.goal: burn a rune into a pylon
quest.hextale.pylon_rune.desc: Pylons have room for runes too. Lay one in the rune circle... I'd like it to reach further and move faster.
jei.hextale.info.gathering_pylon: On a container it reaches for the items lying around and lowers them in. With nothing under it, it passes them along its links. (Right click with an empty hand - what it does now)
jei.hextale.info.sending_pylon: On a container it carries what comes out of it to wherever I point. A furnace even sorts what it gets. (Right click the pylon, then the target - link; again - unlink; Shift + right click with an empty hand - drop all links)
jei.hextale.info.relay_pylon: Takes nothing for itself - items and essence only pass through it to its own links. A chain of them reaches far.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.link: Right click, then right click a storage face or a relay: link
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.clear: Sneak + right click with an empty hand: take all links away
block.hextale.gathering_pylon.hint: On a chest it reaches for whatever lies around.
block.hextale.sending_pylon.hint: On a chest it carries what's inside to wherever I point.
block.hextale.relay_pylon.hint: Takes nothing for itself - only passes things on.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.hint.untie: Sneak + right click a linked block with an empty hand: untie it
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace: Every %s s, %s items at a time
goggles.hextale.pylon.untie: Sneak + right click with an empty hand: untie
block.hextale.siphon_pylon.hint: On a jar it pours the essence away as a stream of light.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.siphon: Pours %s mB every %s s, up to %s blocks · links %s/%s
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace_mb: Every %s s, %s mB at a time
quest.hextale.siphon_pylon.desc: Pipes without pipes. Set on a jar, it could draw the essence up and pour it as a stream of light wherever I point.
jei.hextale.info.siphon_pylon: On a jar it pours the essence as a stream of light to whatever takes it. (Right click it, then the target)
item.hextale.pylon_filter.hint: A way to tell a pylon what to take and what to leave. (Right click - set up; on a pylon - set in; Shift on a pylon - take out)
item.hextale.pylon_filter.not_here: A siphon carries essence: give it an Essence Sticker instead
item.hextale.essence_sticker.blank: Blank: right click to choose its essence
item.hextale.essence_sticker.hint: On a jar it should keep out every other essence. A mixture won't get through either.
item.hextale.essence_sticker.not_here: A sticker goes on a jar, a siphon or a relay
gui.hextale.sticker.title: Essence on the sticker
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.list: Only these: only the listed items pass. All but these: the listed items never pass. An empty filter lets everything pass.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.exact: Kind: every stack of that item. Exact: only with the same enchantments, contents and damage.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.tip.rule: Numbers (with "Only these"): keep N - a sending pylon leaves N of each item in its container; fill up to N - an item goes in only while the target holds fewer than N. Scroll over a slot to set N, with shift by ten.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.empty: Empty: everything passes. Put items into the slots.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.blackli: Everything passes except the items here.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.keep: Only these pass, and N of each stays behind.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.summary.limit: Only these pass, each up to N in the target.
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.empty: Click with an item to put it here
gui.hextale.pylon_filter.slot.hint: Click: replace or clear · scroll: N (shift: by ten)
quest.hextale.pylon_filter.desc: The pylons grab everything. I need a way to tell them what to take, what to leave and how much to keep back. (Right click to set it up, then right click a pylon)
quest.hextale.essence_sticker.desc: A little hex-inked label of one essence. On a jar it might keep out everything else. A mixture, though, stays a mixture - no label will split it.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.link.no_load: Nothing here takes items or essence
item.hextale.research_notes.read: Use to read: then you can make it
item.hextale.research_notes.known: You have researched %s already. Hand the notes to another researcher.
item.hextale.research_notes.learned: Researched: %s. You can make it now.
item.hextale.research_notes.rune: Between the lines of the notes a rune is sketched: %s
research.hextale.locked: Research %s at the Research Table first
hextale.protected: Protected: someone else holds this place
gui.hextale.research_table.researched: Researched already: this makes a copy of the notes
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.hint: Start this research over on a fresh sheet with a new board. The paper is lost, the orb and the ink stay.
gui.hextale.research_table.burn.confirm: Click again to burn the parchment
gui.hextale.research_table.goal.hint: Reach it with the ink; a step onto it costs %s of its essence
gui.hextale.research_table.corner.hint: Every step towards this corner is paid with it
book.hextale.runes.title: Runes found: %s
book.hextale.runes.none: Not a single rune yet. They aren't invented - they're found on scrolls in the chests of old places. The deeper and more dangerous the place, the stranger the rune.
gui.hextale.stele.refuse.one_scroll: A scroll takes one rune: clear the rune on the other stele
block.hextale.hextech_altar.write.one_ru: To copy a rune you need a blank scroll in the rune circle and one rune on one stele
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.goal: find a rune scroll and read it
quest.hextale.rune_scroll.desc: Runes can't be invented - only found. Old dungeons, temples, mineshafts... sometimes even the margins of my own notes. When I find one, I read it and it stays with me.
quest.hextale.blank_scroll.desc: Three sheets of paper rolled together. Could a rune I know be copied onto it - and given to someone else?
quest.hextale.written_scroll.goal: copy a rune onto a scroll
quest.hextale.written_scroll.desc: A blank scroll in the rune circle, one rune on a stele. The circle writes the rune out as I know it. Knowledge can travel after all.
jei.hextale.info.blank_scroll: A blank scroll in the rune circle, one rune I know on a stele - and the circle writes it out.
jei.hextale.info.rune_scroll: Runes are found, not invented: in chests of old places. Simple ones lie close to the surface, the strange ones deep in the most dangerous ruins. How well a scroll is written is pure luck.
jei.hextale.info.research_notes: Everything I worked out, written down. Reading it teaches how to make the thing - and the notes can be handed to someone else. (Right click)
item.hextale.unstable_hextech.throw: And if I threw it on purpose? (Right click)
item.hextale.hextech_dust.tooltip: Glitters and tingles. I wonder what it would wake if I sprinkled it on something.
item.hextale.hextech_crystal.tooltip: Cut along its seams, it has finally calmed down.
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_a_bucket: Not enough water for a bucket
block.hextale.crucible.say.full: There is no room for more water
block.hextale.crucible.say.not_boiling: Only boiling water takes things in - heat it from below and wait
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_water: The crucible is dry: pour in a water bucket or water bottles
block.hextale.crucible.status.cold: %s - water %s mB. Light a fire, a campfire, magma or lava under it
block.hextale.dormant_hextech.tooltip: Amethyst, but cold and blue. Something struck it long ago, and it never quite woke up.
block.hextale.hextech_cluster.tooltip: It grew where the bolt broke in - and it is still awake. Cold light, and it bites the fingers.
block.hextale.fulgurite.tooltip: Earth melted into glass along a crooked line. What could burn this hot - and where did it go?
jei.hextale.info.dormant_hextech: It lies in hollows of amethyst, deep under glassy scars in the ground. It breaks into the same restless orbs a storm gives. Has it been waiting all this time for another strike?
jei.hextale.info.fulgurite: The ground melts into this where lightning goes down. The scars branch out like roots of light - somewhere under them, the bolt must have hit something. Melted once more, it clears into smoky glass.
gui.hextale.hex_workbench.no_charge: Not enough charge: put a raw hextech orb or a synthetic crystal into the socket
gui.hextale.hex_workbench.charge.hint: Raw hextech in the socket soaks into the bench as charge (unstable orb %s, crystal grown in shimmer %s, up to %s); every craft spends some.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_workbench.crystal: A raw hextech orb or a synthetic crystal: its charge powers the crafts
gui.hextale.hex_furnace.fuel.hint: Anything that burns in a furnace.
gui.hextale.hex_furnace.locked: This alloy must be researched first
gui.hextale.slot.hex_furnace.input: A metal for the alloy: up to three different ones
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.no_crystal: Put a crystal into the clamp
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.wrong_disc: A crystal is finished only on a master disc
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.heat.hint: Grinding heats the crystal, resting cools it. At the top it cracks.
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.input: Raw hextech, or a hextech crystal to finish
gui.hextale.slot.hex_lapidary.output: The cut stone (or dust, if it shattered)
quest.hextale.hextech_dust.desc: The orb can't take a blow at all. If I throw it, it shatters into glittering dust. Strange - the dust feels just as alive. (Right click to throw)
quest.hextale.hex_workbench.desc: What if I sprinkle the dust on an ordinary crafting table? It sinks into the wood... and the table seems to wake up. It works only while it has charge - a raw orb in its socket should keep it fed.
quest.hextale.crucible.desc: I sprinkle a pinch of hextech dust into an old cauldron - and it comes alive. Boiling water swallows whatever I drop in. But some things don't dissolve; they take on a new shape instead. How could I use that?
quest.hextale.hex_furnace.desc: Dust on a furnace this time. It wakes hungry for metals - two or three at once, melted together. Some alloys it won't touch until I understand them.
quest.hextale.sphalerite.desc: A dull brown stone with honey-coloured grains, deep in the rock like copper, only rarer. Zinc, I think.
quest.hextale.zinc.desc: Raw zinc melts in any furnace. Grey, plain - and exactly what copper was missing.
quest.hextale.hex_lapidary.desc: Raw hextech has hidden seams. If I turn it over a disc until the seam lines up and grind in short strokes, it might split cleanly. Too much heat and it cracks...
quest.hextale.hextech_crystal.desc: Cut along its seams, the orb finally calms down. It holds a charge and doesn't burst. Most of what comes next will be built around one of these.
quest.hextale.hexsteel.desc: Dust melted into iron does not burn off - it stays in the steel, dark blue and stubborn. It keeps an edge like nothing else.
quest.hextale.charged_hexsteel.desc: Hexsteel takes an edge, but it is still only steel. In a crucible that holds lightning and metal it drinks them in and keeps them - thin blue seams along the edges. Is this what a better tool should be made of? Coolant on a hot ingot might do it faster, if I don't mind the fumes.
quest.hextale.wip_charged_plating.desc: The seams keep their spark for days. Laid as plates on the floor, would they pass it on from block to block - and where to?
quest.hextale.engraved_diamond.goal: engrave a diamond on the Lapidary
quest.hextale.engraved_diamond.desc: A diamond is harder than any crystal of ours, and hextech slides off it. Cut to a brilliant, with a groove in its face, it might hold the charge after all. The plain disc only slides over it - the master disc, edged with diamond itself, should bite.
quest.hextale.radiant_alloy.goal: melt Radiant Alloy in the Foundry
quest.hextale.radiant_alloy.desc: The cuttings a gemstone leaves on the bench are too bright to sweep away. Gold, charged steel and that dust, in the Foundry at its very hottest - it comes out white and rings like crystal. Will acid bring out the light in it? Refined Shimmer would do instead of the dust, if the air can take it.
quest.hextale.wip_bright_battery.desc: The alloy holds light the way crystal does. Wrapped round a battery, would it hold twice as much?
quest.hextale.void_carapace.goal: soften Void Chitin in the crucible
quest.hextale.void_carapace.desc: Their shells crack like dry leaves. In a crucible that holds decay they soften and can be pressed flat - a plate light as bark and cold to the touch. Would the Void take its wearer for one of its own?
quest.hextale.wip_void_glass.desc: Ground thin and set in glass, the shell lets the light in but not the haze. A window for sick land?
quest.hextale.void_crystal.goal: study a Void Crystal under the loupe
quest.hextale.void_crystal.desc: Round the breach I hold, the dead rock grows crystals. Dark violet, a black heart, and they pull - at the light, at my hand. I don't dare use one as it is. Not before I've looked at it closely.
quest.hextale.sealed_void_crystal.goal: set a Void Crystal in nullstone
quest.hextale.sealed_void_crystal.desc: Nullstone drinks stray magic. Set round a Void Crystal it drinks the crystal's hunger too, and what is left inside can finally be worked.
quest.hextale.wip_void_lens.desc: Held to the eye, the sealed crystal shows a haze I can't otherwise see. Is this how the land looks to them?
quest.hextale.riftmetal.goal: get Riftmetal from a held breach
quest.hextale.riftmetal.desc: A held breach eats everything I throw in - except Radiant Alloy. That it keeps a while, and then spits it back black, with violet sparks drifting inside. What did it do to the metal in there?
quest.hextale.wip_far_rift.desc: My gates lose each other past a few hundred blocks. Riftmetal came back from the other side once - would a frame of it remember the way?
quest.hextale.riftforged_tools.goal: forge a Riftforged tool on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.riftforged_tools.desc: Riftmetal, a sealed Void crystal and a raw one beside it round the Hexcore - the radiant tools go in and come out darker. Four runes find room in them. Is this the last step, or only the first one into the Void?
quest.hextale.strike_gauntlet.goal: make a Strike Gauntlet on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.strike_gauntlet.desc: A piston in a brass fist, white gold over the knuckles. Held, it gathers its strength in three beats; let go, and rock breaks like bread, or whatever stands in front is thrown back. Hold it too long and it only sighs out steam. (hold and release Use)
quest.hextale.bulwark.desc: Brass plates over iron, and a raw orb set in the chest where the heart would be. It hums when something hits it - and takes some of the blow. Raw hextech clicked onto it keeps it fed. What happens when it runs dry?
quest.hextale.refined_bulwark.desc: The same refinement as the tools: charged steel and an engraved diamond. The plates hold two runes now, and the heart takes more of each blow.
quest.hextale.radiant_bulwark.goal: make Radiant Bulwark on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.radiant_bulwark.desc: White gold etched with acid, a gemstone for a heart. Three runes, and half of every blow stays in the plates.
quest.hextale.riftforged_bulwark.goal: forge Riftforged Bulwark on the Hexcore
quest.hextale.riftforged_bulwark.desc: Riftmetal and the Void's own shells over the radiant plates. Four runes. The creatures of the Void look at me differently in it.
quest.hextale.hexsteel_gear.goal: forge a piece of hexsteel gear
quest.hextale.hexsteel_gear.desc: Hexsteel takes a hammer as well as iron does, only it holds far better. Why not forge plain tools and plates from it? An edge of hexsteel alone dulls, though - a diamond set into it might keep it.
quest.hextale.master_cutting_disc.desc: The old disc is too coarse for the finer cut. Hexsteel edged with diamond might do it - more planes, less room for a mistake.
quest.hextale.wip_auto_workbench.desc: A workbench that repeats a recipe on its own while its charge lasts. My hands would thank me.
quest.hextale.wip_clockwork.desc: Brass gears and springs - little machines wound by hand that keep ticking for a while.
quest.hextale.wip_gas_grenade.desc: A vial in a hinged shell that bursts into a lingering cloud. Better not stand downwind.
quest.hextale.wip_catalyst_salts.desc: Brews boiled dry leave crystals behind. Maybe they make other reactions run faster?
quest.hextale.wip_chem_press.desc: A steam press that crushes ore and flattens metal in one heavy stroke.
quest.hextale.wip_chem_drill.desc: A hissing drill on a hose from the boiler. Fast, loud - and leaking fumes.
quest.hextale.wip_chem_tank_suit.desc: Armour with a tank on the back pumping gas into the wearer. Strength now... and the price later?
quest.hextale.wip_apex_shimmer.desc: A drop that closes any wound at once. I'm afraid of how much the body would want the next one.
quest.hextale.wip_shimmer_engine.desc: Shimmer burned in a pink flame - the strongest fuel I know, and the least stable. An engine on it would roar.
quest.hextale.wip_shimmer_arm.desc: A mechanical arm fed by shimmer, lifting and striking far beyond human strength.
quest.hextale.wip_mutant_reagents.desc: Dosed creatures might shed strange tissue - things no plant or stone could give.
quest.hextale.wip_mutated_beasts.desc: Animals pushed too far by doses: larger, stronger, veined with purple. And not friendly at all.
quest.hextale.wip_fume_hood.desc: The crucible's fumes have to be drawn away. But they'll have to go somewhere.
quest.hextale.wip_gem_sockets.desc: An engraved diamond bends light the way its sign wants. Set in a pylon's lens or a lamp, would it bend what they carry too?
quest.hextale.wip_hex_bow.desc: A crossbow that charges its bolt with a crystal's spark. I can almost hear it.
jei.hextale.info.hex_furnace: A furnace woken by hextech dust. It melts two or three metals together into an alloy on ordinary fuel. Some alloys it won't touch until I understand them.
jei.hextale.info.crucible: A cauldron woken by hextech dust. Water and fire under it - and once it boils, it swallows whatever I drop in. Some things don't dissolve, but take on another shape. The water can be bailed out with a bucket, or boiled off. (Shift + right click with an empty hand - boil off)
jei.hextale.info.hex_workbench: A crafting table woken by hextech dust. Almost every device is made here, and every craft takes a little charge from the raw orb in its socket. What I haven't worked out yet, it won't show.
jei.hextale.info.hex_lapidary: Raw hextech has hidden seams. Turn it until the seam lines up with the disc and grind in short strokes - too much heat, or the wrong angle, and it cracks. A finer disc finishes crystals into gemstones. And a diamond - would the finer disc bite into it?
jei.hextale.info.hextech_dust: A thrown orb shatters into glittering dust. Sprinkled on a crafting table or a furnace, the dust wakes it up. (Right click)
jei.hextale.working.lightning: Lightning on the rod shatters the amethyst - and every crystal touching it.
jei.hextale.working.throw: A thrown orb shatters into dust. (Right click)
jei.hextale.working.awaken: Dust sprinkled on the block wakes it. (Right click)
jei.hextale.working.finish: Finished smooth with a finer disc.
jei.hextale.working.engrave: Only the master disc bites a diamond: a groove cut into its table holds hextech.
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.turn: Turn the crystal (wheel or A/D) until the band glows green
gui.hextale.hex_lapidary.aligned: Green! Hold the mouse or space to grind
block.hextale.crucible.say.no_essences: There is nothing in it for the water to dissolve
jei.hextale.info.essence: One of the essences everything is made of. Things carry them - studying a thing shows which. Searching for an essence's name finds the studied things that carry it.
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.hint: Whirls of wind for the ripe crops around it. Without air essence nearby it just stands still.
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.status: Field %sx%s, a whirl every %s s, air for %s whirls
block.hextale.whirl_reaper.status.becalm: Becalmed: no air essence in the jars nearby
reaper_rune.hextale.shift.desc: The field it watches grows wider.
book.hextale.quest.reaper_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the reaper.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_reaper: Put the Whirl Reaper in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.whirl_reaper.desc: The crystal stirs the air into little whirls. Set among the beds, it might reap the ripe plants for me and leave them ready to grow again. It needs air to work - air essence from a jar nearby.
jei.hextale.info.whirl_reaper: Whirls of wind for every ripe plant in its field. Crops start again from a sprout, melons and pumpkins are lifted off, cane and cactus are cut above the root. It drinks air essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.hint: Grown trees around it had better watch out. It plants new ones, though - and drinks air essence nearby.
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.status: Grove %sx%s, a saw every %s s, air for %s trees
block.hextale.hex_sawmill.status.becalme: Becalmed: no air essence in the jars nearby
sawmill_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The saws fly out more often.
book.hextale.quest.sawmill_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the sawmill.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_sawmill: Put the Whirl Sawmill in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.hex_sawmill.desc: A disc spun by the wind in an old stump. Set in a grove, it might fell the grown trees and plant new ones in their place. My walls of logs are safe, I hope. It runs on air essence too.
jei.hextale.info.hex_sawmill: Fells the grown trees around it, leaves and all, drops everything at the stump and plants a sapling back. Log walls are safe. It drinks air essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.hint: Set it on a chest. Whatever dies around it never touches the ground. It feeds on decay essence nearby.
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.status: Reach %sx%s, decay for %s deaths, %s experience in the crystal
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.status.hungr: Hungry: no decay essence in the jars nearby
block.hextale.greedy_funnel.status.full: Full: the container below takes no more
funnel_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every death leaves more experience in the crystal.
funnel_rune.hextale.spoils.desc: A drop sometimes comes one more.
funnel_rune.hextale.engraving.desc: Now and then the creature's head comes along.
funnel_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a death costs no decay at all.
