funnel_rune.hextale.sponge.desc: Sometimes a death leaves more than its drops: what they are made of seeps into a jar beside the funnel.
book.hextale.quest.funnel_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the funnel.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_funnel: Put the Greedy Funnel in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.greedy_funnel.desc: Nullstone drinks magic - why not what is left of the dead? A bowl of it over a chest, a crystal to hold the experience... Whatever dies near it might never reach the floor. It will want decay to feed on: bones give plenty.
jei.hextale.info.greedy_funnel: Swallows the deaths around it before anything falls: the drops go straight into the container under it, the experience into its crystal (right click to take it). No items or orbs are ever spawned. Feeds on decay essence from jars nearby.
block.hextale.arc_spire.hint: Strikes the hostile creatures around it with arcs of charge - as if a player struck them. Feeds on spark essence nearby. It stands two blocks tall.
block.hextale.arc_spire.status: Reach %sx%s, an arc every %s s at %s creature(s), spark for %s arcs
block.hextale.arc_spire.status.uncharged: Uncharged: no spark essence in the jars nearby
block.hextale.arc_spire.status.waiting: Waiting: the funnel that takes its kills is full
spire_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: Every arc forks to more creatures.
spire_rune.hextale.flash.desc: An arc hits an unhurt creature harder.
spire_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes an arc costs no spark at all.
spire_rune.hextale.beam.desc: The arc leaves as a hot beam now. Whatever it strikes catches fire - and what falls, falls cooked.
book.hextale.quest.spire_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the spire.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_spire: Put the Arc Spire in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.arc_spire.desc: A crystal on a lightning rod, wound with brass... It throws arcs at whatever comes near - but only at what wants to hurt me, I hope. The creatures seem to fall as if I had struck them myself.
jei.hextale.info.arc_spire: Strikes the hostile creatures around it with arcs of charge; the kills count as a player's, so they drop experience and rare loot. Named creatures and bosses are spared. Holds back while the Greedy Funnel that would take its kills is full. Feeds on spark essence from jars nearby. It stands two blocks tall and needs a free block above it.
quest.hextale.binding_chalk.goal: close a figure drawn in Binding Chalk
quest.hextale.binding_chalk.desc: The chalk keeps runes still on the floor. Steeped in shadow, would it hold a living thing as firmly? Only if the figure is closed, I think.
block.hextale.miasma_vent.hint: It breathes on its own and burns nothing. Whatever is hostile around it sickens and slowly chokes - even the walking dead; people and beasts only cough. (A redstone signal shuts it)
quest.hextale.miasma_vent.desc: Some fumes never settle: loosed under a grate, they keep rising on their own. Whatever wanders into them chokes - slowly, and it leaves less than it would by my hand. But the vent asks for nothing at all.
jei.hextale.info.miasma_vent: Every couple of seconds it breathes over the ground around it - four blocks every way, a little below and three up. Whatever is hostile there sickens and loses health, the walking dead too; players, animals and pets only cough. It needs no fuel at all. Nothing struck them, so no experience and no rare loot. (A redstone signal shuts it)
block.hextale.miasma_vent.status.shut: Shut: a redstone signal holds the stack closed
block.hextale.sorting_matrix.hint: On my dump chest it sends everything home - to the chests nearby that already keep the same thing.
block.hextale.hex_pylon.status.sorting: Sorts %s of each item every %s s into storages within %s blocks · links %s/%s
goggles.hextale.pylon.pace_kinds: Every %s s, %s of each item, up to %s kinds
quest.hextale.sorting_matrix.desc: A lattice of lenses over my dump chest. Whatever I throw in, it sends home - to the chest nearby that already holds the same thing. Want a chest for cobblestone? Put one cobblestone in it.
jei.hextale.info.sorting_matrix: On my dump chest it sends everything home - to the chests, barrels and boxes nearby that already hold the same thing. A relay with a filter can become a home too; furnaces get what they cook. What has no home stays put.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Sometimes my hands get faster while I dig.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: The ore seems more generous, as if the pickaxe were lucky.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: More experience from the ore, even from ore that never gave any; plain stone shares a little now and then.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Digging keeps me fed a little, and under water each block gives back a breath.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: In the dark my eyes adjust as I dig.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: When a block opens onto lava, the heat doesn't reach me.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: In the dark a little wisp of light may stay where the block was.
pickaxe_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The pickaxe sometimes shrugs off wear and even mends itself.
reaper_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: A reaped plant sometimes springs back as if bone-mealed.
reaper_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: Sometimes the harvest gives a little extra.
reaper_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: Now and then the harvest comes out golden.
reaper_rune.hextale.spring.desc: Every harvest wets the soil around, and the neighbours may grow a step.
reaper_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: The harvest leaves experience hovering over the reaper.
reaper_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a whirl costs no air at all.
sawmill_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A freshly planted sapling sometimes shoots up into a tree at once.
sawmill_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: The leaves are more generous: saplings, sticks, apples.
sawmill_rune.hextale.blades.desc: A log sometimes gives one more.
sawmill_rune.hextale.photosynthesis.desc: A felled tree may leave a golden apple behind.
sawmill_rune.hextale.hush.desc: Bee nests come down whole and quiet, bees and honey inside.
sawmill_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a tree costs no air at all.
furnace_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Sometimes the ore gives one ingot more.
furnace_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a melt burns no fuel at all.
furnace_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: The longer it works without a pause, the hotter it gets.
furnace_rune.hextale.reforging.desc: Old iron, gold and copper gear melts back into whole ingots, not nuggets.
tool_rune.hextale.mending.desc: The tool sometimes shrugs off wear and even mends itself.
tool_rune.hextale.haste.desc: Sometimes my hands get faster while I work.
tool_rune.hextale.gravity.desc: One blow and the whole tree comes down, leaves and all. (Shift - one block)
tool_rune.hextale.growth.desc: A tree cut at its foot is planted again - from my bag, or sometimes out of nothing.
tool_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: The leaves are more generous: saplings, sticks, apples.
tool_rune.hextale.corrosion.desc: A blow sometimes eats into armour - it hurts more, and the armour wears.
tool_rune.hextale.cache.desc: Soil, sand and gravel sometimes hide a little treasure. Even a rune scroll?
tool_rune.hextale.erosion.desc: The soil around goes with every scoop. (Shift - one block)
tool_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Grass and soil give up seeds, bulbs and saplings.
tool_rune.hextale.withering.desc: A blow sometimes gives a little life back to me.
tool_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: Now and then the blade lets out a spark: it bites the one I strike and leaps on to whoever stands near.
tool_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: A kill sometimes fans my strength for a while.
tool_rune.hextale.flash.desc: The first blow on an unhurt creature lands harder.
tool_rune.hextale.backstab.desc: A blow from behind lands harder. Do they ever look back?
tool_rune.hextale.bleeding.desc: Now and then a cut keeps bleeding after the blow.
tool_rune.hextale.engraving.desc: Sometimes a creature leaves its head behind.
tool_rune.hextale.shockwave.desc: Struck at the ground, the earth rolls ahead in a wave. Whatever stands in its way takes flight. (a charged blow at the ground)
tool_rune.hextale.blink.desc: One step through the shadow - and I am already behind its back. It never sees the blow coming. (right click at a creature)
tool_rune.hextale.detonator.desc: What falls to this blade does not fall quietly. Better not to stand close.
tool_rune.hextale.whirlpool.desc: Sometimes the struck one becomes the middle of a whirlpool, and everything round it is dragged in.
tool_rune.hextale.whirlwind.desc: If I keep striking without a pause, the blade starts to sing and sweeps everything round me.
book.hextale.quest.furnace_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the furnace.
book.hextale.quest.axe_rune.note: A first axe holds only one rune; a better axe should hold more - %s at the very best? A grindstone takes them all off again.
book.hextale.quest.shovel_rune.note: A first shovel holds only one rune; a better shovel should hold more - %s at the very best? A grindstone takes them all off again.
book.hextale.quest.sword_rune.note: A first sword holds only one rune; a better sword should hold more - %s at the very best? A grindstone takes them all off again.

brew.hextale.fuel.use: Burns hot and long - the green flame loves it.
brew.hextale.growth.use: Splash it on the garden and the plants hurry. The young ones grow up too.
brew.hextale.coolant.use: Splash it on fire and lava - neither likes it.
brew.hextale.glow.use: Where it splashes, cold green light stays behind. Creatures start to glow.
brew.hextale.acid.use: Hisses and eats - stone, iron, copper, monsters. The ore it leaves alone.

block.hextale.chem_burner.status.no_fuel: No fuel: a vial of combustible mix or shimmer, or essence through a pipe
jei.hextale.info.chem_burner: An almost invisible green flame, hotter than lava. Whatever stands on it gets heat without coal or blaze powder, and it burns only while that thing works. It feeds on vials of combustible mix or on essence through pipes - the dark murk burns longest.
jei.hextale.info.chem_vial: With the right catalyst the essences in boiling water settle into a brew. A glass bottle on the crucible takes one dose. Some brews are meant to be thrown.
jei.hextale.info.rusted_plating: Acid on iron blocks eats them into rough, rusted plating. Ugly, but good to build with.
burner_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a portion of fuel burns twice as long.
burner_rune.hextale.steam.desc: A brew over it sometimes yields one more dose.
burner_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every brew over it leaves some experience.
burner_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Standing by the lit burner, the heat doesn't touch me.
book.hextale.quest.burner_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the burner.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_burner: Put the Chem Burner in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a burner
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: a burner holds three runes
quest.hextale.chem_vial.desc: With the right catalyst the essences in boiling water settle into a brew - cheap, dirty and strong. Coal could make something that burns. But first I'd better work out the reaction.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.chem_vial: the catalyst into boiling water that holds its essences, then a glass bottle
quest.hextale.chem_glass.desc: Glass dropped into poisoned water comes back green and tough. What poison, though - something from the sea?
book.hextale.quest.scheme.chem_glass: decay in the water, then glass
quest.hextale.chem_burner.desc: An almost invisible green flame, hotter than lava. Whatever stands on it gets heat without coal or blaze powder. It only burns while the thing above it is working.
quest.hextale.rusted_plating.desc: Acid splashed on iron eats it into rough, rusted sheets. Ugly - but I could build with this.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.rusted_plating: a vial of acid thrown at an iron block
subtitles.hextale.crucible.brew: The crucible turns into a brew
brew.hextale.raw_shimmer.use: Burns long and pink. Too rough to drink - it needs refining.
brew.hextale.refined_shimmer.use: One sip: a minute of strength, speed and toughness - and a violet vein that stays (up to five). While the shimmer feeds the veins, about twenty minutes a vial, each one is an extra heart and a harder hit; three veins and I see in the dark, five and my hands never tire. When the feeding runs out the gifts fade until the next vial, nothing worse. Light essence washes a vein out. (Right click - drink)

block.hextale.axolotl_tank.status.hungry: The axolotl is hungry: fish, or a bucket of tropical fish

tank_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a shedding costs no meal.
tank_rune.hextale.healing.desc: Near a fed tank my wounds close by themselves.
still_rune.hextale.steam.desc: Sometimes it drips out a second vial.
still_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every pure vial leaves some experience.
still_rune.hextale.purification.desc: The purest drops sometimes grow into a crystal.
boiler_rune.hextale.purifying_fire.desc: Sometimes a whole batch comes through clean.
lamppost_rune.hextale.purification.desc: It burns off more of the dirt around it.
lamppost_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Now and then a burn costs no light.
lamppost_rune.hextale.healing.desc: In its light my wounds close by themselves.
lamppost_rune.hextale.insight.desc: Anything hostile in its light stands out, even through walls.
boiler_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Less of each batch escapes with the steam.
boiler_rune.hextale.purification.desc: Less of each batch burns down to murk.
brazier_rune.hextale.pollen.desc: A plant in its light sometimes grows as if bone-mealed.
brazier_rune.hextale.healing.desc: In its light my wounds close by themselves.
brazier_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: Sometimes a vial burns twice as long.

quest.hextale.shimmerbloom.desc: Deep underground some caves glow violet from wall to wall. The flower that lights them seems to dream. What would it leave in boiling water?
quest.hextale.wip_shimmer_bed.desc: The moss under the blooms is soft and faintly warm. Would they grow faster on it, away from their cave?
quest.hextale.axolotl_tank.desc: An axolotl heals faster than anything alive. If I keep one in a glass tank and feed it fish... maybe it sheds what it doesn't need.
quest.hextale.regenerative_slime.desc: A lump of slime, still warm and alive with healing. The axolotl doesn't miss it at all.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.regenerative_s: an axolotl and fish in the tank
quest.hextale.raw_shimmer.desc: The blooms leave something dreamy in the water, and the slime seems to want it. Together, over a strong fire... the water turns violet. Raw shimmer. I have to understand this one first.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.raw_shimmer: 6 rift and 4 light in the water, then the slime
quest.hextale.chem_still.desc: A copper still over the green flame. Raw shimmer goes round the swan neck and drips out clearer. Two rough vials for one pure.
quest.hextale.chem_boiler.desc: A pressure tank over the green flame. A mixture goes in, the valve knocks - and everything runs out at once, each essence into a jar with its label. Crude: part of it goes up with the steam. Is the speed worth it?
quest.hextale.refined_shimmer.desc: Pure shimmer glows magenta. One sip and I feel stronger than I should be... but the body needs time before the next. It also burns better than anything I know.
quest.hextale.shimmer_veins.desc: Every vial leaves a vein - the icon beside my effects shows how many. While the shimmer feeds them (about twenty minutes a vial, less the more veins I have) each vein is one more heart and a harder hit; three and I see in the dark, five and my hands never tire. When it wears off the veins fade and the gifts with them - no harm, only the pull of the next vial.
quest.hextale.veins_washed.desc: A bottle of essence with plenty of light in it (8 mB or more) - and one vein fades from my arm. So the shimmer can be undone.
book.hextale.quest.scheme.refined_shimme: raw shimmer in a still over a lit burner
quest.hextale.pink_brazier.desc: Shimmer burning in an iron cage: the pink flame burns nothing it touches, yet the stakes the cage stands on grow warm, and so does the soil around them. The plants on it seem to hurry. How far does the warmth go?
quest.hextale.synthetic_crystal.desc: Amethyst and dust steeped in pure shimmer grow into a crystal. Weaker than a cut one - but the workbench socket takes it all the same, and no storm is needed. Could it stand in for a cut crystal elsewhere too? It wouldn't last as long.
jei.hextale.info.shimmerbloom: Only deep underground, in caves that glow violet - most caves have none. It grows on floors and ceilings; bone meal plants a new one beside it.
jei.hextale.info.axolotl_tank: An axolotl in a glass tank, fed on fish. Now and then it sheds a lump of healing slime. A bucket brings it in and out unharmed.
jei.hextale.info.regenerative_slime: A lump of slime, still alive with healing. In boiling water full of dream and light, over a strong fire, it turns violet...
jei.hextale.info.chem_still: A copper still over the green flame. Two rough vials of shimmer go in, one pure drips out.
jei.hextale.info.chem_boiler: A riveted tank on a Chem Burner. Mixtures come in by pipe, by bottle, or out of plain jars of mixture nearby; cracked, every essence runs into a jar within reach that wears its sticker. Part of each batch is lost to fumes, part burns down into the flame.
jei.hextale.info.hextech_lamppost: Two blocks tall, it drinks light essence from a jar nearby. In its light part of the dark my work stirs up burns away, and the sickness of the land around stops at its post.
jei.hextale.info.pink_brazier: Shimmer burning in a fire cage whose stakes go into the ground. The soil around it grows warm, and the plants on it grow faster. The flame itself never burns anything.
jei.hextale.info.synthetic_crystal: Grown from amethyst, dust and pure shimmer. Cheaper than a storm's crystal, weaker too - the workbench takes it for charge, and the devices that hold off the Void take it in place of a cut crystal, until it crumbles.
quest.hextale.lab_bench.desc: For chemtech I will need other tools. A flask, droppers, a flame under the glass... Let's see what can be done with this.
book.hextale.quest.lab_first: Work it out at the Lab Bench first: %s
quest.hextale.growth_tonic.desc: Bone meal boiled into something green and eager. Splashed on the garden... I think the plants would hurry.
quest.hextale.coolant.desc: A snowball boiled into something that stays cold even in the heat. Fire wouldn't like it. Neither would lava.
quest.hextale.glow_mix.desc: Glowstone dust over a strong fire turns into a mix that glows by itself. Where it splashes, it might leave light behind.
quest.hextale.acid.desc: A fermented spider eye, only over the hottest green flame. It hisses and smokes. Stone, iron, monsters - I wonder what it won't eat.
lab_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a drop costs no essence.
lab_rune.hextale.radiance.desc: Every sealed experiment leaves some experience.
lab_rune.hextale.heat_eater.desc: A flask about to burst sometimes lets its pressure out by itself.
book.hextale.quest.lab_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the bench.

item.hextale.hextech_skypack.hint: Two tanks of air around a crystal. A take-off from the ground fires the jets for a couple of seconds, then the crystal just holds me up as I glide. Every take-off drinks some air - I must keep an eye on it.

item.hextale.hextech_skypack.no_air: No air essence in this jar

subtitles.hextale.rift_gate.break: A rift gate is left alone
skypack_rune.hextale.motor.desc: The jets push harder: I fly faster.
skypack_rune.hextale.bellows.desc: The jets catch with a kick that throws me forward.
skypack_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Sometimes a take-off costs no air.
skypack_rune.hextale.breath.desc: Walls and the ground seem softer while I fly and right after.
skypack_rune.hextale.fireproofing.desc: Fire does not touch me while I fly, nor for a while after I land.
skypack_rune.hextale.flamethrower.desc: The jets burn so hot now that whatever chases me through the flame catches fire. Strange - the grass below stays untouched.
book.hextale.quest.skypack_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the pack.

block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the skypack holds three runes
quest.hextale.hextech_skypack.desc: If a stable gemstone can make things float, could it carry me? Air essence in two tanks, the gemstone between them, nozzles below. A jump, a second jump in the air - and then what?
jei.hextale.info.hextech_skypack: Worn like elytra. With air essence in its tanks: jump, then jump again in the air. A take-off from the ground fires the jets for two seconds like a firework rocket; after that it glides until the next take-off from the ground. Each take-off costs air. Refill from Essence Jars: right click one with the pack, or sneak beside them wearing it.
quest.hextale.magic_wood.desc: The pale wood keeps a faint warmth, as if it still remembers the essence it grew from. Sparks don't catch on it - good wood for a workshop.
quest.hextale.wip_scribes_desk.desc: Wood that won't burn - a good desk for a careless candle. Would the ink lie better on it, too?
quest.hextale.arcane_cloth.goal: make Arcane Cloth in the crucible
quest.hextale.arcane_cloth.desc: Wool left in water full of magic comes out heavy and warm, and the essence never washes out of it. What could I sew from it?
quest.hextale.researcher_robe.desc: Pockets for bottles and a high collar against the sparks, a deep hood against the ash, wraps at the knee, boots for the long roads to the storms. In this I could stand closer to the crucible - and to the storm.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_banishing.desc: In the dark my eyes get used to it at once.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_radiance.desc: Experience I gather seems to grow on the way.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_breath.desc: Under water my breath lasts longer.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_mending.desc: The cloth heals its own tears - on all my clothes.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_healing.desc: Sometimes a blow wakes a slow healing.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_fireproofing.d: When fire catches the robe, it stops burning me.
clothes_rune.hextale.trousers_windmill.d: I jump higher than I should.
clothes_rune.hextale.boots_pollen.desc: Crops and saplings by my path sometimes shoot up.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_purification.d: Poison and weakness sometimes just wash off.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_mirror.desc: Sometimes a blow glances back at whoever struck.
clothes_rune.hextale.trousers_shift.desc: I step up onto blocks without jumping.
clothes_rune.hextale.trousers_magnet.des: Loose things around me drift into my pockets. When I want them to stay where they are, I crouch.
clothes_rune.hextale.boots_quenching.des: Hot stone hardly burns my feet.
clothes_rune.hextale.hood_mirage.desc: When a blow leaves me barely standing, the air round me bends and I slip out of sight. Whoever hunts me runs at a figure of light instead. Then the hood needs time to gather again.
clothes_rune.hextale.robe_static.desc: The cloth keeps a charge. Whoever comes close enough to strike me gets a spark back and stands numb for a moment.
clothes_rune.hextale.boots_wavewalk.desc: The water holds my steps like a floor, and I even walk faster on it. Under it, it no longer clings to my feet. (sneak to sink)

quest.hextale.wip_essence_satchel.desc: Bottles clink and break in my pockets. A bag lined with the cloth might hold essence without any glass at all.
quest.hextale.wip_living_metal.desc: Hexsteel left inside the core overnight is warm in the morning and closes its own scratches. Is it still metal at all?
quest.hextale.wip_radiant_alloy.desc: Gold and gemstone dust melted in the core's light come out white. It rings like crystal and never tarnishes. Tools for a lifetime?
quest.hextale.wip_living_armor.desc: The Bulwark's heart beats, but the metal round it stays dead. Grown on the core instead of forged, would armour mend its own dents - and learn its wearer?
quest.hextale.wip_shifting_hammer.desc: A hammer that unfolds into something that fires. Two tools in one head - if the runes agree to share it.
quest.hextale.wip_core_rituals.desc: The core forges what the altar refuses - but so far only metal. Would it make devices too, things with a will of their own?
quest.hextale.rune_chalk.desc: Magic stone ground with dust draws a line that does not smudge. A circle on the floor first - then whatever will stand inside it. (Right click the top of a block)
quest.hextale.nullstone.desc: Calcite steeped in ash and shadow comes out of the crucible grey and heavy. Magic near it goes quiet. If rituals start getting out of hand, this might calm them - but how much can one stone drink?
quest.hextale.crystal_battery.desc: Somewhere to keep hextech's charge for later. A crystal in a brass cage - and the workbenches nearby never run dry. The machines I'm dreaming of will be hungry.
item.hextale.rune_chalk.hint: The lines do not smudge. Around the altar or the rune circle the work seems to go quicker - or am I imagining it?
item.hextale.rune_chalk.controls: (Right click the top of a block: draw a rune)
item.hextale.binding_chalk.hint: The same chalk, steeped in shadow - it draws lines that want to close. Whatever stands inside a closed one stops, as if it forgot how to move. How long can a line hold?
item.hextale.binding_chalk.controls: (Right click the top of a block: draw a line)
jei.hextale.info.binding_chalk: Lines of shadowed chalk join like a thread. Closed round a patch of floor, they wake and hold whatever stands inside - a few creatures hang still, quiet as statues, though a blade still reaches them; a person only stumbles for a moment. Bosses do not care. The holding drinks shadow from jars nearby; with none, the chalk itself wears thin and a line gives way. A touch wipes a line. (Right click the top of a block to draw)
jei.hextale.info.rune_chalk: Draws a rune on top of a solid block. Runes around a Ritual Altar or a Rune Circle make its rituals go quicker - the more, the quicker, up to ten - and glow while it works. A touch wipes them away.
jei.hextale.info.nullstone: Drinks stray magic. Near a Hexcore at work each stone takes some of its anger, and fills up with it - its veins glow brighter. A full stone stops drinking and slowly lets it out again. Made in the crucible: calcite in ash and shadow essence.
jei.hextale.info.crystal_battery: Keeps hextech charge. Give it raw orbs or crystals grown in shimmer; it feeds the Awakened Workbenches around it. The fuller it is, the brighter its core - a comparator reads it too. (Right click with an orb; with an empty hand - the charge)
battery_rune.hextale.cache.desc: The cage seems to hold more than it should.
battery_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.des: The charge jumps further to the workbenches.
battery_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Now and then a crystal gives half as much again.
battery_rune.hextale.sunlight_cell.desc: Left under the open sky, the battery seems to drink the daylight. Night and rain stop it.

block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the battery holds three runes
block.hextale.hex_foundry.hint: An iron door that wants a whole kiln of fire bricks around it. Then a pinch of hextech dust.
block.hextale.hex_foundry.alone: The hatch needs its kiln of fire bricks around it
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.heat.cold: Still waking: nothing melts below the mark
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.heat.hint: The hotter, the faster every piece melts
gui.hextale.hex_foundry.fire.hint: Furnace fuel, or fire and magma essence from jars nearby or pipes
foundry_rune.hextale.forge.desc: Sometimes ore gives one ingot more.
foundry_rune.hextale.eternal_flame.desc: The fire sometimes burns without eating anything.
foundry_rune.hextale.tempering.desc: It burns hotter than the bricks should allow.
foundry_rune.hextale.smelting.desc: Molten stone and sand sometimes leave a grain of metal in the slag.
book.hextale.quest.foundry_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the hatch.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_foundry: Put the Foundry Hatch in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
quest.hextale.fire_bricks.desc: Clay with sand and gravel kneaded in, baked hard. Pale bricks that do not crack in a fire. What could be built of them?
quest.hextale.hex_foundry.goal: build a Foundry and light it
quest.hextale.hex_foundry.desc: One furnace at a time is too slow. A whole kiln of fire bricks, hollow inside, a grate on top and an iron hatch in front... Slow to warm, I expect - but once it glows, does it swallow everything at once?
jei.hextale.info.hex_foundry: Built into the front of a 3x3x3 kiln of fire bricks (hollow inside, iron bars in the middle of the top) and woken with a pinch of hextech dust. Slow to heat; hot, it melts all nine inputs at once. Burns fuel or fire and magma essence from jars nearby. Things dropped on top fall in.

block.hextale.hollowbloom.tooltip: A dead bush that woke up hungry. Where the world grows thin, it comes alive. Better keep it near home and glance at it now and then.
item.hextale.void_chitin.tooltip: A shard of shell from something that came out of the Void. Light and cold, and not a scratch takes it. What could stand against them, if not their own skin?
quest.hextale.void_chitin.desc: What crawls out of a breach leaves pieces of its shell behind. Hard as stone, light as bone. I'll keep them and take a closer look - maybe one day they become armour against their owners.
quest.hextale.the_thinning.desc: At dusk a lilac haze lies low over the grass, and dark specks sink into the earth as if it were drinking them. It was not like this before. Everything I boil out of things, brew in the crucible and spill has to go somewhere - is this where? Should I try to wash it out of the land, or wait and see what it turns into?
quest.hextale.hollowbloom.desc: The haze comes and goes, and I can't tell how far it has gone. A pinch of dust on a dead bush, and the bush stirs where magic wears the world thin - long before the eye sees anything. Something to plant by the door and watch.
quest.hextale.let_it_spread: What If I Let It Be?
quest.hextale.let_it_spread.desc: I could try to hold it back - brew less, spill nothing, unmake nothing. Or I could do nothing at all and watch what it wants to become. Careless? Probably. But somebody has to write down what happens next.
quest.hextale.void_blight.goal: find land the Void has taken
quest.hextale.void_blight.desc: The grass went to ash first, then the ground itself gave way: soft black soil, stone gone glassy and violet. It still cuts like ordinary rock. Whatever lives here now has no need of the sun.
quest.hextale.void_flora.goal: study a Void plant under the loupe
quest.hextale.void_flora.desc: Glassy coral, roots that move when I look away, bulbs glowing from within. Nobody planted them, and they grow only on sick ground. Do they feed on the sickness - or carry it further?
quest.hextale.wip_void_garden.desc: They only grow where the world is thin. Potted, fed, kept - what would they give back?
quest.hextale.void_mites.desc: Small and cold, and they don't bite - they hold on. With every one my heart beats a little weaker. They let go only after a potion of healing. What are they drinking: the magic, or the life?
quest.hextale.void_breach.desc: The ground shook, everything was pulled to one point, and the world tore. There is nothing inside, no magic at all, and it pulls. Something crawled out of it and came straight at me. It will not close by itself. Could it be held? And would it starve if the land around it healed?
quest.hextale.void_chitin.goal: study Void Chitin under the loupe
quest.hextale.wip_void_carapace.desc: Armour of their own shells. Would the Void take its wearer for one of its own?
jei.hextale.info.hollowbloom: A dead bush woken with hextech dust. The thinner the world around it, the more alive it is: dry twigs on clean land, a glowing bloom where the Void is near. A comparator set beside it seems to catch its pulse. (Right click a dead bush with hextech dust)
jei.hextale.info.void_chitin: Left behind by the creatures of the Void when they do not get away.
subtitles.hextale.voidling.emerge: Something pushes out of the Void

hextale.configuration.showWipSteps.toolt: Show the devices still being worked out in the researcher's diary.
hextale.configuration.runeSigns.tooltip: Which rune signs are drawn when a rune works: all, all but your own, or none (runes still glint).

item.hextale.clouded_crystal.tooltip: Hextech gone dark with the Void it drank. Cold, and heavier than it should be.
purifier_rune.hextale.purification.desc: The crystal takes in more before it clouds.
purifier_rune.hextale.fertility.desc: Land it heals sometimes bursts into grass and flowers.
purifier_rune.hextale.dam.desc: Now and then a draw burns no light.
book.hextale.quest.purifier_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the purifier.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_purifier: Put the Crystal Purifier in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to a purifier
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the purifier holds three runes
jei.hextale.info.hextech_purifier: Its crystal drinks the sickest land around and clouds over as it fills; once clouded through it has to come out - a hopper below would do. It burns light essence from the jars nearby.
jei.hextale.info.clouded_crystal: Comes out of a Crystal Purifier once its crystal has drunk its fill.
quest.hextale.cleanse_land.desc: Nullstone drinks stray magic - and on sick land the dark of the ground rises right into it. A few stones where I work, and the haze may never come. But what about land that is already lost?
quest.hextale.hextech_purifier.desc: A crystal hung point down over a font of clear water, and the land around gives up its dark to it. Light essence seems to keep it awake. It clouds as it drinks - and then? (a crystal in hand to set it, an empty hand to take it out)
quest.hextale.hextech_lamppost.desc: A lamp on a tall post, a crystal in its head. In its light the dark my work stirs up seems to burn away before it settles... It only shines with light essence near it.
quest.hextale.clouded_crystal.desc: The crystal came out dark and heavy, and something moves inside it when I look away. The Void, caught and held. Throwing it away feels wrong. What could it be good for?
quest.hextale.wip_clouded_lens.desc: Something moves inside it when I look away. Set in a lamp, would it show where the world is thinning?
quest.hextale.healed_land.desc: Where the Thinning is drawn back out, the black soil turns to earth again and the glassy growths wither. The grass remembers its colour after all.
quest.hextale.breach_fades.desc: The breach feeds on sick land. Heal enough of it, and it shrinks, gutters and closes - unless something holds it open. Was it hungry, or only lost?
block.hextale.void_anchor.hint: A standing stone of nullstone with a crystal hung in its window. By a breach it seems to take hold of the edge nearest to it.
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.empty: No crystal: put a hextech or synthetic crystal in
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.clouded: The crystal is clouded through: swap it
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.free: No breach within reach; the crystal is %s%% clouded
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.held: Holds the breach; the crystal is %s%% clouded
block.hextale.void_anchor.status.fightin: The breach fights back - the ring is not closed; the crystal is %s%% clouded
anchor_rune.hextale.chain_lightning.desc: Arcs leap from the crystal into the Void's creatures near it.
anchor_rune.hextale.banishing.desc: The Void's creatures near it slow down and shine.
book.hextale.quest.anchor_rune.note: Room for %s runes in the anchor.
jei.hextale.rune_burning.note_anchor: Put the Void Anchor in the Rune Circle; up to %s runes.
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.not_: %s does not take to an anchor
block.hextale.hextech_altar.engrave.full: No room for %s: the anchor holds two runes
jei.hextale.info.void_anchor: Six of them around a breach, one on every side - and it stops spreading and keeps still. Holding clouds their crystals; they need changing before the ring breaks. Through them a held breach seems to swallow the murky leftovers from the jars nearby.
quest.hextale.void_anchor.desc: A standing stone of nullstone with a crystal in its window: set near a breach, it ties a thread of light to its edge. One will not hold it - the breach fights and sends its spawn out sooner. And one on every side? (a crystal in hand to set it, an empty hand to take it out)
quest.hextale.subdued_breach.goal: hold a breach with anchors on every side
quest.hextale.subdued_breach.desc: The ring closed, and the magenta cooled to a cold violet. Nothing crawls out, the land around stops sickening. A wound that stopped bleeding - but still a wound. The crystals cloud as they hold it; how long will the ring last?
quest.hextale.void_maw.desc: The Void eats magic. The murky leftovers in the jars by the anchors run along the threads and vanish, and the land around is a little healthier with every gulp. Whatever is thrown in vanishes too. Will it ever be full?
quest.hextale.void_incubator.goal: see a fed breach give birth
quest.hextale.void_incubator.desc: Fed enough, the held breach pushes something out - one at a time, when it is ready. After a big meal, a grown one. A shell worth having... but it is still a hunter.
quest.hextale.kept_breach.goal: keep a held breach on healed land
quest.hextale.kept_breach.desc: First hold it, then heal the land around: the soil is clean again, and the breach is still here, quiet in the middle of it. A piece of the Void right by the house. Wasn't this where it was all heading?
quest.hextale.voidling_growth.desc: The one by the breach is bigger than the first. They feed on magic - on the breach, on what they kill - and shed their shells as they grow. How big would one get if no one stopped it?
item.hextale.breach_heart.tooltip: A whole breach folded down to the size of a fist. It beats - cold, heavy, pulling at the hand. Where should it open again?
item.hextale.breach_heart.controls: Use on the ground to let it unfold. Left lying loose, it unfolds by itself.
item.hextale.breach_heart.needs_ground: It needs firm ground under it
item.hextale.breach_heart.no_room: There is no room for it to open here
block.hextale.void_anchor.fold.not_held: This anchor holds nothing that could be folded
jei.hextale.info.breach_heart: A held breach folds into it when a Clouded Crystal is pressed to one of its anchors (sneak and use). Carried, it slows you down. Used on the ground, it unfolds into the same breach - wild again until six anchors hold it. Dropped, it unfolds by itself after half a minute.
quest.hextale.breach_heart.goal: fold a held breach: sneak and press a Clouded Crystal to one of its anchors
quest.hextale.breach_heart.desc: The crystal went into it along the thread, and the whole breach wound in on itself until it fit in my hand. It beats. It is heavy in a way that has nothing to do with weight. Could I carry it anywhere I like?
quest.hextale.breach_moved.desc: It opened again as if it had always been here - the same outline, the same hunger, and wild once more. The old place is quiet now. So a breach can be put where it is wanted. Who else has thought of that?
